notes.title: Happy Programmer's Day!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/7b6af01c598fa66eb98175a954113cd6c905ffd2.png[/img]

Hey friends!

The 256th day of the year is also known as Programmer's Day! That's today.

A huge kudos to all the knights of ones and zeroes, present-day, former, and wannabes alike! Without you, there would be no video games!

If coding at work is not enough for you (we get it) - did you know that there's a dedicated page on Steam's programming games? Check it out:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/tags/en/Programming][h2]Browse Programming games on Steam[/h2][/url]

As for our own programming games - you know where to find them:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3818770/SuperWEIRD

https://store.steampowered.com/app/619150/while_True_learn

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1724140/Craftomation_101_Programming__Craft

notes.title: Learning Factory Is 39% Off, And More Exciting News!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/5b1fcd9bf66b1b3b88c48848ea843c673d5820d2.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

As you may know already, Learning Factory is on sale this week, with a handsome discount of 39%!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

But if you're reading this, you're probably interested in more games from us. And we've got a brand new game from a brand new internal team for you. Meet SuperWEIRD:

[previewyoutube=kXrbZnNGFHg;full][/previewyoutube]

It's a co-op automation adventure set in… we're not sure? (Seriously, pigs in shades? Fish with hats?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/3aef780190872215fcba58c0bbf133b34ba8bd5f.png[/img]

But it's ok: all you have to do is repair everything, clear this place of corruption, and defeat a bunch of manic monsters. Then you'll get outta here (maybe)! 

Use flags to set tasks for hordes of rusty robots! Make them work for you - crafting stuff, making swords and shields - everything can be done by hand, but also automated by tuning the system of flags.

...and/or it all can be done with a little help from your friends:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/1c8edfa40db1aa2107f4433a5efca3ac054fff89.png[/img]

After everything is set up, watch your army of dysfunctional warriors as they march towards their doom!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/dd454b775396dfb20048a39825dbe3d4af729fdc.png[/img]

You can wishlist SuperWEIRD right away, and also apply for the future playtest - we'll need your feedback to make this game even more awesome:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3818770/SuperWEIRD/

notes.title: Some More Good News & Updates From the Devs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/71f30a676d0fdb433dae9af63b517228086555bd.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

We hope that you're having a great Summer Sale, and your Steam library is full of awesome new games (again).

As for us, we've got some exciting news of our own! For one, [b]while True: learn()[/b] is expected to become a part of exposition in a hi-tech museum in Antwerpen (that's in Belgium)

Craftomation 101, in turn, is getting a lift-up in the UI/UX department: we've hired professional designer to make the game shine, and she's doing an awesome job:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/14c107a551992f4c151aafb7a25fcd441e8b1e04.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/5d6e57e7470444992ad2ff50f8766563a3d4a8c2.gif[/img]

The next update for that game is just around the corner!

As for [b]Learning Factory[/b], it now [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150090/view/503944742841616014]comes with a controller support[/url], which kind of makes it one of the friendliest factory-building games out there:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/97143333553c15e2dbf68214a4312ebd29dcfa18.png[/img]

Last but not least: have you heard of our new games? One of them is called [url=https://superweird.shop]SuperWEIRD[/url]. It's a tower defense adventure with automation and some resource management, and it looks exacly as the name suggests:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/a0e0be81ec3da01d623fac906dbf2f5c1a1b13ac.png[/img]

So many games, huh? Are we allowed to wear game publisher hats now? Just kidding, we're still keeping things simple, with all games being done by less than 20 people. So we're still your friendly neighborhood indie devs, who will do their best to bring you tons of fun!

We'll get back to it now. Until we meet again!

P.S. We're also doing tons of videos on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ludenio]YouTube channel[/url] these days, so there's no reason to not subscribe for it. See you there!

notes.title: Dr Katz Reporting - About Voiceover
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/03dd985f6789de6f28edbf4dd8d85e711c4c4b2a.png[/img]

Hey!

We heard a lot of positive feedback about our voiceover! We are really happy about it and want you to meet our voice actors!

[h1]English[/h1]

The Original. The Legend. Dr Katz originally is voiced by Ali Gohar. We made a lot of iterations to perfect the cat speech of mad scientists. The main reference for a character was Dock Brown from "Back to the Future" and various cartoon cats.

As a result, we got a great voiceover which Ali himself rated as "This is PURRRFECT!" after playing the game and we used his voice as a reference to all other languages.

Ali Gohar
[list]
[*] https://www.fiverr.com/voiceoverali?source=inbox
[/list]

[h1]Russian[/h1]

So here we got a bit lucky twice. I have a few friends in "Maly Theatre" in Moscow and some of them recommended Artem Zatiev to us. He is not only a voice actor (agent ISO in Valorant for example) but also an actor in Theatre and Cinema.

And the second time we got lucky because we have a great character reference for all Russian speakers - "Matroskin the Cat" from "Three from Prostokvashino". This cartoon is not only famous but also beloved by all Russian people.

Artem Zatiev
[list]
[*] https://www.kinopoisk.ru/name/5818723/?ysclid=m7ad3h2n4g417603441&utm_referrer=yandex.ru
[*] https://www.litres.ru/author/artem-zatiev/?ysclid=m7ad3yoc4z511927066
[*] @art_zatiev in Instagram
[/list]

[h1]Chinese[/h1]

And with Chinese localization we also got lucky. The man behind the Chinese version of Dr Katz is a member of our team - Peter Weng. Peter has been working with us since While True Learn() and among other things he is the author of Chinese localization for both games. When we tried to find an actor for this role he volunteered and the result is great!

[h1]Brazilian-Portuguese[/h1]

Hold on, this voice isn't in the game yet. At least not publicly available. But it is done and will be released next week. Sadly we can't add a sample to the news, but trust me, it will be glorious.

Ramon M
[list]
[*] https://www.fiverr.com/ramongmaia?source=inbox
[/list]

[h1]What next?[/h1]

There is more? Yes! Korean and French localizations are being recorded and will be added in a patch or two. But that is not all, we are trying to find voice actors for German, Polish and Japanese, and some more!

Back to work engineers!

notes.title: Legendary Patch - v1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8f68a9f5fc6c1fdd901707db879151a606b0eb31.jpg[/img]

For the last two weeks, we've been reading reviews, watching Twitch streams, and YouTube videos nonstop, slowly going crazy! So the patch turned out to be pretty big and nice. Worth it. Send more feedback and bug reports! We love the smell of feedback in the morning.

[h2]v1.0.2 Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Patch Highlight - 15 new Legendary Cats[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/0a812322764e4a97266842dedfb1d6777f583a78.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/846c2939f7f8418ee0218f8ac9ed518d1d6bf5ca.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8ab01a7b20dfb18fb09acfc62f785b11458c2b6c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/47169c53e6988072bcaf229b7f769916a1f1994b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/461499baf2512cb78edf042ec5eff2a54134e93a.png[/img]

Cat you meet them all?

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lumber Mill work speed upgrade research cost reduced from 500 to 200
[*] X-switcher research cost reduced from 200 to 150
[*] Reverse Splitter research cost reduced from 300 to 200
[*] Chance of perks with "Can Use Data X" reduced
[*] Perks with "Can Use Data X" now give 10% quality of 10% experience
[*] Campaign map improved
[*] Some Trading deals buffed
[*] A lot of new visual features for customer cats
[*] Advertising Cat Gates now by default summon cats ONLY with 1 item type, it can be changed in the UI. So they are easier to use
[*] Many Legendary Cats have more money
[*] Campaign and Freeplay maps generation is improved
[*] Removing Fertilized plant now refunds a Fertilizer

notes.title: 3, 2, 1... Catopia! - Learning Factory Retrospective
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/dc8b85e9090e275de7f4b73c849c3082892b6d0d.png[/img]
Hey, engineers,

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1150090/announcements/detail/575998175465177667]As promised[/url], we're back with some more nostalgic Learning Factory content.

This week is special because (a friendly reminder) Learning Factory goes to v1.0 release on January 27! If you have the game on wishlist, you'll get an email once it's out there. And if not - it's about time to add it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

If we count the pre-release stage, the development took almost 5 years, which is… wow. To be honest, we just wanted to make a nice little tycoon-like game with cats in it, but then our players asked for more content, one thing led to another - and here we are.

It's been a long way. The game has evolved tremendously. Just one example: do you know what capsule art on Steam is? It's that picture you see just above a game's description, it's the ‘face’ of the game, in a way. Check out how this image was changing throughout the years, as we were fine-tuning our vision of Learning Factory:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/9be9bef769e84b7a8e8d1d89546d91266b8143b6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/dbe85615678e0002768dfab0f75a25d912dbe071.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/7b19ce1c65c7f8e3e1a39f91ed8c7f7ee00d7cf4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a4aefb9c0085a6e46b7d03eb88b5803cf2e60cde.jpg[/img]

We won't bother you with too much text today - there will be time for words later. As for now, we're still heads-down busy, making the final preparations for the release.

So we'll let the screenshots talk. Take a moment and look at how Learning Factory was evolving in every possible way:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/ccad6556887b2ccb923555f182660bcdf9825fdb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/9c76a70d8449630a0888c45c126bd2f17341bf32.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/d6264429031a416521d46e1427005ce8cbcf5373.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/09561f183d9e0b386f2392b1308e94f37c6438a9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/70d9b0b2280feb0d3356f64fd5705536cde3356e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/5bf5b0b19c3c0e69abf1c3c52aca360ad6e3a5c1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/210231b6b02ea3ba3ad07ccb160ef10a53ca0d73.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/031e7d577f33716c606f4d3b248713b9455644d6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/af2aae4fd7390d07de5bbe6c7d843d996041eaf4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/b09d8e29826f5d8e39f12f6d336ac7725b327e5e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/128a1741533101247143eeb17c774ad6f541b907.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/904be1d10540e5664465f6a77dc08432af09a2f9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/7a84faeb8deca5bd2e6530cd7733a7b6159e6cb4.png[/img]

We wouldn't let you go without sharing another portion of weird facts about Learning Factory though! Enjoy.

[h3]Learning Factory Trivia, Part 2[/h3]
[list]
[*] The original plan was to allow cats visit multiple stores, like in theme park tycoons
[*] We discussed a concept in which a player would have to manage a huge storage unit and plan the amount of goods to order according to the demand
[*] There were no plans for adding an underground level, initially
[*] However, the game now supports an almost unlimited amount of levels. We wanted to have more than just two, but it turned out to be madness in many ways
[*] The idea of Learning Factory was first drafted because the players of while True: learn() were asking for gameplay in which real-life machine learning could be applied
[*] [b]while True: learn()[/b] players were asking for real-life programming gameplay, which resulted in us making [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1724140/Craftomation_101/][b]Craftomation 101[/b][/url]. But that's a whole different story.
[/list]
Come join us in celebration of Learning Factory release this Monday! Catopia won't build itself, you know.

Until we meet again!

notes.title: Learning Factory Goes v1.0 on 01/27/2025 - Cats go to Mars!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/70393912eb7a08e98999f55389bba3e3f8115074.png[/img]

Hey, engineers!

You've seen the title, haven't you? The big day is on the calendar. Our palms are shaking while we're typing in these words.

[b]Learning Factory goes out of Early Access on January 27![/b]

We even got ourselves a professional trailer, that's how committed we are:

[previewyoutube=PDDGuagYU68;full][/previewyoutube]

And here's how it all started - Learning Factory's first teaser, February 2021:

[previewyoutube=FmWrlKF13mU;full][/previewyoutube]

You'll see a lot more Learning Factory nostalgia on the upcoming week. We've started drafting the game back in the spring of 2020, so there's a lot to remember.

But today, we'll be looking into the future, namely, that release day of ours. Here's a short summary of what's going to happen:

[list]
[*] On January 27 we will release the final v1.0 update. It will feature extended voiceover, the final part of the story, and many improvements in QoL and UI/UX parts.
[*] There will be an extended release discount
[*] After the discount ends, the price will be increased, as we stated in our Early Access manifesto
[/list]
Here's another retro Learning Factory trailer for you to enjoy while digesting the information above:

[previewyoutube=5KT2-bHSmNk;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, here's a checklist of actions you can take right now to ensure that you don't miss the big v1.0 celebration:

[list]
[*] Add Learning Factory to your wishlist, if it's not there yet - this way you'll get an email from Valve once the game and the discount go live
[*] If you have a friend who might like the game - spread the word!
[*] If you know a content maker on YouTube, Twitch etc., who might enjoy covering the game - let us know in the comments, we'll reach out to them!
[*] Buy the game on January 27, obviously. If you're sincerely enjoying our work, we are preparing a special DLC with exclusive materials, for our biggest fans
[/list]
Oh look! Here goes another retro trailer of Learning Factory! Sereiously, the excuse of posting them again was one of the main reasons for this post:

[previewyoutube=DaWAdBeqgVQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Did you know we were updating the footage for those trailers every half a year or so? Well, there's a lot of stuff about Learning Factory that you might not've known! We'll start fixing it today (and continue in the next couple of posts):

[h3]Learning Factory Trivia, Part 1[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game was initially meant to be a tycoon in which cats would choose which stores to attend
[*] Data and coins initially were in-game objects, moving on the Transporters as any other item
[*] There used to be a day and night cycle in the early versions of the game
[*] We had our regrets about naming the game ‘Learning Facotry’ (search it on YouTube to see the [url=https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=learning+factory]ridiculously irrelevant results[/url]), but it was too late
[*] We created an [url=https://luden.io/lfedu/]educational version[/url] of Learning Factory in collaboration with Games for Change foundation
[*] Learning Factory continues the story of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/619150/while_True_learn/]while True: learn()[/url] in which a software engineer invents a cat-to-human translator device
[/list]
We wouldn't let you go without suggesting another selection of old trailers! In the next posts, there will be more ancient art, screenshots, and whatnot!

This is August '22, when the new art style emerged. We also tried experimenting with the narrative:

[previewyoutube=fGDkiHNxA5E;full][/previewyoutube]

Narrative-shnarrative, we had it discarded by the end of that year. Who needs narrative, when you have Zeppelins:

[previewyoutube=Xj-E77CgaNk;full][/previewyoutube]

Until it finally came to this last in-housee iteration. We'll miss you, buddy:

[previewyoutube=cOzR8EMad8w;full][/previewyoutube]

You won't find this on YouTube anymore, fellas (we unlisted those old-timers)! Which one you like better? Let us know in the comments.

Until we meet again!

notes.title: Preparing for the Big Day - Learning Factory Dev Diaries, October 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/fceebbb761c269f564bc5452f318eb61e8923683.png[/img]

We have to admit: in the upcoming few month,s these developer diaries will be progressively more boring, at least in terms of news. The game is basically finished in terms of gameplay. There's a lot of testing and polishing to be done still but nothing grand will probably happen to the game until we hit that big ‘release’ button.

And then there's some art to be added, too! This means our dev diaries will at least be entertaining to scroll through, even without new killer features. The remaining few months before the v1.0 release will fly by momentarily, as time always does, you'll see!

However, this time there's much to be told, too! For one, we released the biggest update for Learning Factory in September. It pushes the game so much closer to its final state, that we have jumped from v0.3 to v0.9

The main reason this update was delayed for a few weeks was the infamous summer vacation season (even the most passionate of the game devs must take some time away once in a while!). But it was also a great time to thoroughly study the feedback from our players, take a look at the game with rested eyes, and make some necessary improvements.

There were many upgrades and balance tweaks that came along with v0.9 that made the game more comfortable and flexible. The full (and rather long: 100+ points) list of changes can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150090/view/4345495562216601021]here[/url].

We won't list everything here but we have something better: video highlights! Check out these newly animated buildings in Learning Factory:

[previewyoutube=Lhy0azSakTQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Occasional new buildings still make it to the game once in a while. Here's another advertising building which promotes laser pointers and also served us a great excuse to make yet another pop culture reference:

[previewyoutube=TFNIcWsm8y0;full][/previewyoutube]

And this new building is meant for logistics fanatics: the structure of our game does not allow making Transporters faster, so we created this machine for packing items into archives, and then unpacking them, when needed:

[previewyoutube=zAn0AhkxlO4;full][/previewyoutube]

A big part of our work is about many things around the game: the menus, the tutorials - things like that. We added over a dozen mini-guides explaining the trickier aspects of the game, and we’ll probably add some more (and likely accompany them with animated illustrations in the future).

As for the menus, they’re slowly coming into lighter, more modern form all over the game. Check out how the Research Tree changed a couple of weeks ago.

Old:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/08e3d227ff4cfae2d90deb32f0faf802ddf57cef.jpg[/img]

New:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/e0aa1022e17342323e215a236f119c75dd84013f.png[/img]

Already existing structures get a lift up as well. Check out our more detailed redesigned Monument:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8b2773f750fcd6c60fffc37dba44059aea3e5a02.png[/img]

And the Trade Ports were upgraded with landing sites, with Zeppelins flying in and out to deliver the goods to the mysterious cat Guilds:

[previewyoutube=bW1BXSWkejc;full][/previewyoutube]

But perhaps one of the most time-consuming tasks was re-rendering Learning Factory's innumerous variations of Transporters, Splitters, Mergers and such. While Sergei the artist was at it, he got so deep into his early work that he started finding creepy-ish objects that never made it to the game, like this magnificent lineup of Tunnels:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/b42b84c14cfe130fb301238a2ef61b444f14c523.jpg[/img]

One day we will gather and share as many weird artifacts like that as we will find, but this will happen once Learning Factory is properly released. Until then, there is more excitingly boring work on polishing the game. More tutorials, more visual upgrades, and vital QoL changes, hooray!

The big day is coming. We’ll be in touch!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/132d4025d2a3f8419a94471058fd57ede3be934e.png[/img]

Hey, engineers!

Noticed how we jumped from v0.3 to v0.9? That's how serious we are about releasing the game! This is the final Major update before v1.0.

We did our best to meet this giant leap in version number. Just check the long list of changes that this update brings to Learning Factory:

[h2]v0.90.185 Released![/h2]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] New building: Item Archiver allows you to speed up the logistics by increasing the throughput of Transporter lines and Manipulators. Comes with 2 upgrades
[*] New service building in the late game: Shooting Range motivates the cats to buy Laser Pointers; also it can be placed underground
[/list]
[previewyoutube=TFNIcWsm8y0;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] An upgrade that increases the speed of Cat Vitamin crafting (Suggested by [i]shlainn[/i])
[*] An upgrade for increasing Wohlwill Purifier operational speed
[*] An upgrade for increasing Tech Overcharger operational speed
[*] An upgrade for increasing Land Digger operational speed (suggested by [i]JoneY[/i])
[*] An upgrade for increasing Lava Cooler operational speed (suggested by [i]JoneY[/i])
[*] An upgrade for placing Transporters and Cables in deep water without terraforming - enter Deep Ocean Bridge
[*] An upgrade for Bridge Crafter, allowing crafting of Deep Ocean Bridges
[*] Launching an Expedition with upgraded Catopia Ark modules provides Deep Ocean Bridges in New Game+
[*] Decreased cost of the upgrade allowing to craft Lava Bridges
[*] Decreased cost of unlocking and crafting Lava Bridges
[*] Increased cost of research for Long Manipulator
[*] Both upgrades for Fertilizer Dispenser were buffed
[*] Upgrade for increasing Jetboard speed when flying over water was buffed (suggested by [i]Дима Тертичный[/i])
[*] Cargo Zeppelins now have 3 slots for items
[*] Decreased crafting cost for Soil and Fertile Soil
[*] Decreased cost of research for Storage
[*] Logistics Assembler is now available earlier in the game and easier to research
[*] Inventory Teleport is now easier to research
[*] Cable Crafter is now easier to research
[*] Fishing Pier and Fishing Spot can now be placed on Bridges
[*] Juice production recipe's efficiency increased (suggested by [i]Дима Тертичный[/i])
[*] Base speed for all Zeppelin types slightly increased
[*] Item capacity increased from 20 to 30 items in various buildings
[*] Added a new tier-4 trade deal with the Cat Puns Union guild, allowing you to get Hard Rock Dynamite
[*] Selected trade deals in Trade Ports rebalanced
[*] Campaign map slightly improved
[*] More random buildings appear on territories in Freeplay Mode maps
[*] New achievement
[*] 4 new stats in 'Stats & Scores' section of the Monument
[*] Improved logic of cat generation to prevent generating too many cats of the same type in a row
[*] Minor changes in the distribution and the order of cats emerging in the early parts of the game
[*] Increased the threshold for advancing research projects with points from Cat Knowledge archives from 25% to 33%
[/list]
[previewyoutube=zAn0AhkxlO4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Graphics && Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] New visuals for Trade Ports: Zeppelins now land from outside of the map to deliver goods
[*] New visuals for Concrete
[*] Animated Hammock Testing Booth
[*] Animated Scratch-Testing Booth
[*] Animated Schrodinger's Chamber
[*] Animated Bling Machine
[*] Animated Microchip Maker
[*] Animated Battery Maker
[*] Re-rendered Logistics Assembler
[*] Re-rendered Storage units (for better display with a zoomed out camera)
[*] Re-rendered Graphic Card Assembler
[*] Re-rendered Soil Silo
[*] Re-rendered Enriched Soil Silo
[*] Re-rendered Polynomial Regression
[*] Re-rendered Cat Gate
[*] Re-rendered Target Ad Cat Gate
[*] Re-rendered Exit Cat Gate
[*] Re-rendered Optic Cable/Vertical Cable
[*] Re-rendered Sphinx
[*] Re-rendered Monument
[*] Re-rendered Cat Blimps
[*] Re-rendered Geothermal Furnace
[*] Re-rendered Turing Trees with more diverse sprites
[*] 1 new color for Zeppelins
[*] Visual effects for Hedge when the player crosses them over
[*] 21 line with voice over for Dr. Katz
[*] Improved logics for switching ambient tracks
[*] Improved logics for switching biome-specific tracks
[/list]
[previewyoutube=bW1BXSWkejc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Modding && Steam Workshop[/h2]
[list]
[*] Custom localizations available as a mod
[*] Added an option to upload a custom preview image for Steam Workshop mods
[*] New mod: generative map features are now available in the Scenario Editor, thus allowing editing them and creating scenarios with different territories
[*] Not part of the patch note but a friendly reminder: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3141284038]here's a little guide[/url] about making mods for Learning Factory
[/list]

[*] Monument interface updated (partially)
[*] Hotkeys for buildings can be assigned on hovering them in the buildings' crafting window
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/e0aa1022e17342323e215a236f119c75dd84013f.png[/img]

[*] Improved Twitch integration
[*] Optimized saved game loading time
[*] Optimized Storage units performance
[*] Optimized Transporter performance
[*] Optimized Zeppelin performance

[*] Bug fixes, kudos to [i]Bass, rolo9, Sana, your_local_rin, Jay🥸, W, DLC prepared Ajnador, M0mb0t, hobbitfolk, Behemoth, Sunsphere11, 3fr41n, Дима Тертичный[/i], and, especially [i]JoneY[/i]
[/list]

[b]Q:[/b] "bonjour pourquoi aucun chat ne sort de la porte de chat
en scenario personnaliser" (Google Translate: "hello why no cat comes out of the cat door in scenario customize") [i]-florian.guilloud[/i]
[b]A:[/b] To make cats appear in a custom scenario, one must toggle them in the upper panel when setting up the scenario. Additionally, at least one item that respective cat types are looking for must be available in a scenario, otherwise those cats will not emerge on a Factory

notes.title: The 4 features that didn't make it - Learning Factory Dev Diaries, August 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/66af2b3a2a5e3b39a23527e90892fc120957137b.png[/img]

As your game gets closer to the release, you tend to look back more and more often. How many years has it been? Learning Factory was [url=https://ludenio.itch.io/catfunfactory]first drafted[/url] during the early pandemic months of 2020. Four and a half years in development is no record, but the density of events matters: we started with a quite different game. Let's talk about that today!

To set up the mood, check out this short video of how the game looked back in pre-alpha times vs. 2 years ago vs. today:

[previewyoutube=_e1LWPLBWXI;full][/previewyoutube]

(It doesn't cover even half of the changes we made, so there probably will be more videos like that in the future)

Since we started digging up the past, we decided to remember some of the features that had been in the game initially, but disappeared under not so mysterious circumstances.

[h3]Day & night cycles[/h3]
Learning Factory was contemplated to be a more compact game, with a good part of gameplay revolving around machine learning. It was more of a tycoon than a factory-building experience, in which the player would run a shop for cats by day and train machine learning with fresh sales data by night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/546c25ab852f079be7a526050867339eb90eb7b1.jpg[/img]

It turned out that machine learning models were not as interesting to tinker with for most players to make up a half of the game, while making and selling items was way more fun to be just the other half of the gameplay.

From then on, the proportions of the gameplay started changing, which resulted in Learning Factory of today. With giant factories and machine learning models working quitely behind the scenes, always ready for interaction and experiments, but demanding almost no attention from the players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/e598a99044495450f9bebe097fd3a33a1fdee302.jpg[/img]

And with that, there was no more point of having a day/night cycle anymore. But hey, we have beatiful clouds and particle effects from plants today!

[h3]Turing Trees as part of gameplay[/h3]
The increased scale of gameplay affected a bunch of our ideas that initially looked prominent. For example, some resources such as organics were initially planned to be either finite or at least hard to reproduce. There were no fertilizers, no fertile soil, and if one would root out all the trees on the map, they would effectively soft lock their game.

On the other hand, Turing Trees would could be used to prevent this from happening: as they're multiplying according to the rules of the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conway%27s_Game_of_Life]Game of Life[/url], they were a Turing-complete entity, which one could use for all kinds of things, like running DOOM with them (even if only hypothetically).

Or at least creating a park with self-replicating trees, since Turing Trees could be harvested for Wood back in the day! Here’s a little video (also serving as a reminder of that weird terrain we used to have until the spring of 2021):

[previewyoutube=kg1nvA6VN88;full][/previewyoutube]

This feature also turned out to be not very tempting for most of the players, as everyone kept asking for more and more cat-related content! Which is why Turing Trees now only exist for decorative purpose. But you probably can still run DOOM with them!

As for the content, producing and selling items could be even more diverse, but…

[h3]Items quality as real numbers[/h3]
The current system of item quality only has 3 levels, but what if there would be, say, 100 of them? That would be possible if we'd measure quality with decimal fractions, so that any item could be of 55% quality, for example. This would open a way for an array of hardcore mechanics: the quality of item, for example, would take into account various modifiers and conditions, the same way as the probability of critical strike in action games consitsts is influenced by weapon/armor bonuses, buffs and debuffs…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/f842f62bb322cdce7595f167fa05271325f64028.jpg[/img]

Which would be really cool, but by the time we got to implementing quality mechanics, we realised that having quality measured in real numbers would become a colossal challenge for optimizing the game and would likely make the game way less of a zen experience.

[h3]Ships for Zeppelins & multiple map layers[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/7b12a87b12f1fa485806945adc60cf19c99ccf09.jpg[/img]

Another part of the gameplay that we changed because we didn't want to overload the players’ minds, is Zeppelins, that were initially meant to be ‘Ships’ (and even ‘Cars’ in the initial draft), which would use reinforced learning to find routes from point A to B. Cars were discarded pretty quickly, as the ground part of the map is usually occupied with buildings and Transporters, that often change their positions because players are rebuilding their factories all the time.

Ships were seen as a simpler alternative, as oceans in Learning Factory have less buildings and resources, and a simple model would sooner or later figure out a decent way to travel around them. However, there still were too many chances for the players and/or models to mess things up while setting routes in the ocean, which would result in increased levels of micromanagement and frustration. That's why we decided to stick with the Zeppelins for the time being: there are no obstacles in the sky, and setting up a chain of logistics there is much simpler.

But what if there would be islands in the clouds as well? That could have easily happened, because the map in Learning Factory is designed to support more than just 2 layers. Imagine having 3, 4… maybe even 9 levels for your factories, with all kinds of connections and paths for goods and cats on them… If you think it would be a logistic nightmare - that's exactly what we thought, so we decided to stick with just 2 levels for now. But here's another piece from our archives - a video of a multi-layered map. Those Transporter letters do not really disappear, it's us changing levels:

[previewyoutube=NdYZ1y0vTMs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
That's just the tip of the iceberg of stories about what has changed in Learning Factory since we started working on it, so expect another nostalgic post some time in the future. But not too soon though: we're just coming back from summer vacations and accumulating mana before that big leap towards the release! Here's a little teaser of what waits you in the next updates:

[previewyoutube=WTAv8mHam2s;full][/previewyoutube]

What are these cats preparing for? Stay tuned and you'll find out! Until we meet again.

notes.title: Every Little Thing - Learning Factory Dev Diaries, July 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/60220ad8d9aad662f4e677d6ea6c12c28f391dde.png[/img]

Hey factory builders,

Here we are, with yet another report about how Learning Factory’s being prepared for the full release. There’s not much to tell, but there’s a bunch of things to show! 

For starters, we’ve freshened up Steam page assets (again), because the game has changed greatly since last revision (which took place in November ‘23). With that said, here’s the most up-to-date Learning Factory trailer:

[previewyoutube=cOzR8EMad8w;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, here’s a handful of new screenshots:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/55a7065406529dc925ac275d558c3a2d6c747cf8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/358e602005bedbe8251dc23844afb28f90d4e689.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/b73b6c80e2baa4e1096d78b25b3a69dc25210c07.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/70affb53ec2a7f3485a3c876f13047f2f3220179.jpg[/img]

And of course, an array of Learning Factory’s machinery acquired animations/new looks in the past month. Here’re the new Linear Regression, Milk Drill, Brew Intensifier, Fish Maker, and Smoothie Maker:

[previewyoutube=LBk15uV3BNw;full][/previewyoutube]

Machine Learning Models got some cyberpunk vibes as well:

[previewyoutube=qRE4hUB5ISY;full][/previewyoutube]

And just in case you didn't notice them in the trailer - here are our new Cat Stores:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/0e2de52eb91c8e0cd0c9e70199d41a1ef3f68772.jpg[/img]

Apart from the visual side, the most interesting changes are happening with the game's structure, namely - with the tutorials. Throughout these years, Learning Factory has incorporated mechanics that added a lot of depth to the gameplay but were not so easy to discover and understand. 

Previously, in-game Wiki and descriptions on the Research Tree were the player's main source of information about those parts of the game, but seriously, who wants to search through bits of text for instructions in the XXI century?

So we have spent some time and left a bunch of short and intelligible tutorial sessions here and there in the game. You will learn how to handle Deposit and lay underground infrastructure, deal with service buildings and storage units, use sales data, and much more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/1c1f7270efae1e8424bc5d012a7dcca0f71b7eb2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a51b58fbf16ca1448d24506fb7f5bf504241ac4b.jpg[/img]

We already have about a dozen tutorials, and we'll probably add at least as many in future updates. Some of them have illustrations now, but eventually, we plan to add short videos to these bite-sized tutorials. From how to use Docks and Zeppelins, to the tiniest interface tricks, such as the pipette tool, we'll try to leave no chance for misunderstanding.

This would be a nice excuse for you to start a new game: chances are good, you'll learn about something entirely new! Or has it already happened to you? [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Let us know[/url] if you stumbled upon a feature you never knew to exist in Learning Factory!

Not that we'd want to post any spoilers, but… basically, we'll be working on the same things in July. More new graphics, more tutorials, more UI/UX improvements. If that does not sound very exciting to you, that's ok: just wait until we're done and you’ll see Learning Factory the way we see it in our minds - that will be the time to get excited!

Until we meet again.

notes.title: Every Detail Matters - New Update, v0.31.184
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/b57cfe7b5c3399a8c7fc6ea312b63c80e2a6ba9e.png[/img]

Hey engineers,

When you get to design a factory, every small detail matters! And not only because you're working with complicated machinery, where everything will break if a detail breaks (do you like silly jokes as we do? share your favorites in the comments!). It is also important because we want you to feel comfortable while playing Learning Factory.

Which is why this new update is dedicated to making game prettier, along with making complicated mechanics more easy to learn!

[h2]v0.31.184 Released![/h2]
[list]
[*] Re-rendered Vitamin Maker
[*] New phrases for cats, specific for their place of origin
[*] Increased speed (by 1 tick) for selective Manipulators (suggested by [i]S'Kleer[/i])
[*] Increased size of bubbles for cat phrases on Transporters and in Stores, to facilitate reading
[*] New premade Blueprint for Cargo Docks, available in the Wiki
[*] New premade Blueprint for the tutorial
[*] New item requests and cat types appear less frequently in early parts of the game
[*] Performance optimization
[*] UI/UX improvements
[*] Tutorial fixes/improvements
[*] Improved tutorial upon picking a Cat Knowledge Archive
[*] Bug fixes (kudos to [i]VladGev[/i], [i]U[A]T morningstar2651[/i], [i]Malolitrazhka[/i])
[*] Massive community localization update for the German language (kudos to [i]Bass[/i])
[*] Improved Steam Deck interface
[*] 1 new unique cat researcher
[*] A new item per each categories of appearance for cat researchers (3 items total)
[/list]
[h2]Re: Factory[/h2]

[i]In this section of patch notes, we answer the questions from the community that were submitted via the in-game feedback form and/or seemed especially interesting to us, You can always contact us directly in the comments or join our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url][/i]

[b]Q:[/b] "My life would be so much easier if selective manipulators worked faster, because I need 4 of them to load/unload a Dock, and it gets clumsy" [i]-S'Kleer[/i]
[b]A:[/b] We'd like to make it so Manipulators would occupy 1*2 tiles instead of 1*3 tiles so they wouldn't occupy so much space. But since they were not designed to be of that size from the beginning, it would take too much work to change them. So we've tuned up their operational speed, which is supposed to make more comfortable to work with, as one would need less Manipulators to achieve the same result.

[b]Q:[/b] "My game froze during the map change, or at least it didn't continue loading. I even have it on video since I was recording at the time. With an interstitial sequence, I was asked if I wanted to pack my things and get to know another map. After some text exchanges at the bottom of the loading screen, no new line appeared. I waited an additional four minutes, then I exited using ALT+F4." [i]-Emanuel - Vito[/i]
[b]A:[/b] Please send us a saved game filee and/or a video of your gameplay, so we could better detect and fix this issue! Contact us at info@luden.io, or on our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url].

A friendly reminder: you can always chat with us directly on our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url]. We're using Discord for work, so you'll find many of us there most of the time, don't be a stranger!

An even friendlier reminder: don't forget about our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1150090]collection of items in Steam Points Shop[/url]! Sergei the artist makes wonderful factory art to be observed from above, but his works' magic really shows at close-up perspective:

notes.title: The Great Beauty (of Mars) - Learning Factory Dev Diaries, May 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/566eae3672d00dfdd65e5d117ca08440a0c94984.png[/img]

Pretty much as your Factory evolves from a humble Yarn Ball-selling store to a continent-wide industrial/scientific/commercial cluster, Learning Factory, the game, has grown a lot in the past couple of years. And when it comes to bringing such a game to the full release, one thing certainly leads to another: there are so many buildings now, and we must make them all animated! And if the buildings are animated, why don’t we animate those Transporters, too? Etc., etc...

Which is why this edition of our developer diaries mostly consists of short videos and pretty pictures! Even if your playing Learning Factory zoomed out to the max, animated machinery creates an unforgettable image of the whole factory working like one single machine. But if you zoom in to the ground, you will notice that every building’s design is full of details. And it’s even better when they’re animated! With the latest update, we’ve reworked just 2 buildings, but check out the difference (and some moving Transporters, too):

[previewyoutube=JDz0LtueSAI;full][/previewyoutube]

Animation of buildings looks inspiring even when you look under the cape. This is Catnip Juice Brewery’s animation in the editor:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/fcb383f4e6c61a3b74d03423030695d5bc8fee9f.jpg[/img]

In one of the previous updates we also made Catnip Algae Harvester’s animation smoother, but it’s not just that! Zooming your camera is now way smoother, too! Take a look at it (and some more moving Transporters):

[previewyoutube=vQzrj_ASPCw;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re talking about Transporters so much, because it really took us a lot of time to come up with the right tile design, arrows’ shape and color, and animation details. And the process is far from being complete! For example, a couple of days back we had a very vivid discussion about the colors of crossroad arrow. Here’s what we were choosing from:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/519d4c55a334c8a2537724a556696476276fa0c9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/0a018770583a9c89c545d45e343728ba4ee45904.jpg[/img]

Which one do you like more? Let us know!

Our next target for visual reboot are the mysterious Cat Knowledge Archives, which are scattered around the map and serve as catalyst to your scientific breakthroughs. According to our scientists, they were left on Mars by the Interstellar Lazy-Laborer Union for Mars Integration and Never-ending Aspiration for Technologic Innovation (a.k.a. the I.L.L.U.M.I.N.A.T.I.). Meaning that they simply must look scientific and mysterious. Like so:

[previewyoutube=u1z20dIrXLU;full][/previewyoutube]

After all those videos, one might think that only Sergei the artist is working on the game at the moment, but this couldn’t be further from the truth! It’s just that most of the work is happening around the cape and cannot (yet) be turned into pretty visuals. Polishing is happening on every level, and one of our big tasks for the upcoming weeks is improving tutorials and interfaces - there are many fun mechanics that influence the gameplay in Learning Factory, but not all of them are properly presented to the players. And since we’re making a cozy game here, our mission is to make the first contact with it as comfortable for the players, as we can.

In other words, the evolution from janky-Early-Access-title to a shiny-awesome-v1.0-title is happening as you are reading these lines! Already we can’t wait to tell you more about that - but we’ll hold our breath for another month or so.

But if you have any questions - we suggest you ask us directly, we’re a very open bunch of developers! Leave a comment, or go straight to our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url], where some of us is almost always online.

Until we meet again!

P.S. This edition of developer diaries was supposed to be posted here last Saturday, but it got delayed due to the fact that the author accidentally adopeted a street cat:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/04ced2d321562421002e389b42cf4b5276c9feea.jpg[/img]

We've got a total of 11 cats in our team, and counting!

notes.title: The next frontiers - Learning Factory Dev Diaries, April 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/90d71892f3d9ff1c955f6ff7bc01f565db193bae.png[/img]

Hey factory builders!

Time goes by, v1.0 release is getting closer, and Learning Factory is becoming more polished, more complete, and more… alive? We suppose one could say so: there's obviously more action around the KOTOVOD campus, so let's talk about that.

[b][i]If you want to read the extended version of these Diaries with more images, [url=https;//ludenio.substack.com]subscribe to out mailing list[/url][/i][/b]

Sometimes one factory is just not enough. Good that we now have the New Game+ mode to fix that! After you send out your first Catopia Ark expedition, you will be able to move to a planet it lands on.

The planet surface may be rather quirky (because it's generated), but you can prepare in advance: upgrading your Ark modules and fueling them with appropriate items provides you with significant bonuses, including additional buildings, better relations with Trade Guilds, extra terraforming tools, and much more! A great way to start a new game with new, unpredictable challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/94da581d5298db04f111acc121973005d4f9e957.png[/img]

If you head over to your Tavern, Dormitory, or one of your Labs, you'll notice that residing cats have a lot to say to you now! The official version is that cat-to-human transmitter, that was supposed to be working this whole time, was set to mute instead. Seriously though, we saw it in one of the YouTube videos about Learning Factory, and decided that we need that in the game! Another excuse to add more cat-related puns and references, too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/669832713e19b2bfeeef62160971f20ac6f5928b.png[/img]

And while that thing is just for fun, animated Transporters that we're working on now, serve a greater purpose of making your factory look alive. Here's an example of how they look now, in beta mode:

[previewyoutube=D8scPyWsuc4;full][/previewyoutube]

You can turn it on and see for yourself in the game right now, but they will emerge in full glory within the next couple of weeks. We can't say for sure how long will it take, but conservative scenario is to release them in late May.

There are many iterations, because Transporters are one of the main structures in the game, and we want them to look real smooth when they're done, so we're taking this part of the game very seriously!

Among the changes in the past few updates there were a couple that do not sound very impressive, but do make game experience so much better. For example, many steps were made to optimize various parts of the game. Now the Zeppelins, Transporter laying, the growth of plants, and many other things run smoother than ever before.

Our in-game wiki has gone through a bunch of transformations as well. In the beginning, it was just describing objects at the Factory and provided some basic information about data science in real life. But now it also serves as your compendium for knowing how items are produced and sold around your factory. Use it at any time:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/ec6c9fe78393e2ef24c43696c97261228ce927ab.png[/img]

Of course, there were more fixes and fine tuning, and this is how it will most likely be in the upcoming months: all big things are in place, and now it's all about small details - which is where the proverbial devil is! These next months are going to be full of exciting grind.

With that in mind - we'll be back in a month, with more Learning Factory news! Or we can chat earlier - on our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url], for example. Until we meet again!

[*] Cats in the Tavern, Dormitory, and Labs will now occasionally talk and make cat sounds

[/list]
[h3]QoL && Interface[/h3]

[*] Improved tutorial

[*] Added a context warning when there's a chance of a Linear Regression overfitting
[*] New accessibility option: more intense building highlighting (the color is also adjustable)

[*] Added an option to turn off automatic cloud saves synchronization, for users with many saved games and slower internet connection

notes.title: Rollin', Rollin', Rollin' - Learning Factory Dev Diaries, March 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8d0a7e9491d770ae14c3f801f75db765de145a48.jpg[/img]

It's been a long time, how have you been? We, as the title suggests, have been rollin’!

[b][i]If you want to read the extended version of these Diaries with more images, [url=https;//ludenio.substack.com]subscribe to out mailing list[/url][/i][/b]

We've rolled out a whole new game to Early Access: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1724140/Craftomation_101_Programming__Craft/][b]Craftomation 101[/b][/url] had a very nice start, and you're very welcome to check it out, be it the free demo, or the full game.

We've rolled out a demo for Learning Factory too! Got a friend who doesn't own the game yet? Let them know, they can now try it and, hopefully, fall in love with it. Because we have cats, automation, and machine learning, who could resist the temptation?!

And we keep rolling out updates for the game every two weeks, of course. Since we were not in touch for the whole two months, lots of things happened.

[h3]Steam Workshop is (mostly) open for business![/h3]

We always develop our games with mods on our minds, and in-game ways to share your works - such as map keys and scenarios - have been there for years. But now you can conveniently upload the fruits of your creative genius to Steam Workshop - as well as access the works of other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/030129aa6448fb23323cf4f29789435dcc6e23e8.jpg[/img]

It is still in beta, but already you can upload your factories, blueprints, map generation keys, researcher bios and ruins (decorations that appear on any map upon generation and selected randomly from the pool).

If you need just a little push to start, some very simple and graphic instructions on making and uploading mods can be [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3141284038&snr=1_2108_9__2107]found here[/url]. Happy modding!

[h3]Meowengers: Endgame[/h3]
Although we're still working on the New Game+ mechanics, the framework for setting Catopia Arks all over the Universe is already in the game. After you launch your first expedition to space, a whole new set of upgrades for the next Arks: you'll be able to equip them with Copycat Deck, Creative Assembling Machine, Battlestar Gun Deck, Interstellar Store, Dune Terraforming Deck, Warp Storage, and Negative Mass Effect Generator! Here's an ‘old vs. new’ image, so you could appreciate how badass they are:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8589b3f39da8fbfb60ee5fe4d4516b0f6d98c944.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8789ed3dac2fd8e8763242cc778d4d8df6caf714.jpg[/img]

For the moment they don't do anything, except for being an eye candy. But come the next updates, unlocking these tech New Game+ mechanics will introduce you to the New Game+ mode, in which you won't have to start from scratch… Follow the news, or even better, [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]join our Discord[/url], where you can get instantly notified when the new stuff is out, and discuss it with us in the same place.

In that very same update, we introduced a huge list of QoL changes, as part of our ultimate pre-release polishing program. There are improved bits of tutorial, new stats, new contextual warnings, and new little features all over the game. Even Steam Deck, though officially not yet supported, got some attention!

We won't list all the changes here, you might not even instantly notice them if you haven't played the game for a while, but they're certainly there to make your life better! Oh, but if you do want to see that list, it is to be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150090/view/4195736292004772733]here[/url].

[h3]Something old, something new[/h3]
Even at this time of meticulous polishing, we are not stopping to add new content to the game. Sometimes ideas are coming from us, trying to add more depth to Learning Factory - quite literally at this time! Behold Lava Pump, that is capable of extracting precious metals straight from the molten core of Mars!

In the video below you might also notice the newly added Underground Storage units, which might not seem like a big deal, but it doubles potential storage space by extending it under the surface of the red planet:

[previewyoutube=d5sJUgEjqps;full][/previewyoutube]

And sometimes, our players inspire us: we noticed that some players hardly ever use Trade Ports because they're located at remote parts of the map. It happens that players establish their own production of goods that Ports offer by the time they unlock one of them, thus rendering Trade Ports obsolete. So, we made a smaller version of them.

Enter Trade Relays! They get unlocked significantly earlier and closer to the center of the map but have limited deals to offer. Naturally, all 5 Trade Guilds have their own relay design:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/635e3929368fbf361504e48d856f4cdb5d9fe8b1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a0a4844b8556f4a1896b6b0822005c578fbac88c.gif[/img]

The remaining three are for you to discover in the game. We can't spoil everything, can we (though we would love to)?

We're also experimenting with visual effects for the environment, to make a game look lively. It's just one of our early efforts, but what do you folks think?

[previewyoutube=g7jur_O9Kpg;full][/previewyoutube]

The older buildings are also getting updated looks. Remember Data Storage? Here it is now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/2075a57ef6246ebf92a62fbbcc0283ad92fb9997.gif[/img]

And this is its partner, Linear Regression:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/c6c721499aaacde537c5f52c2a385fc5025156d4.gif[/img]

[h3]What’s next?[/h3]
The main highlight of the upcoming patch (scheduled for the upcoming week) is the option to migrate to another map shortly after finishing the tutorial. You will keep your research progress, and your buildings will be packed into your Inventory for your convenience.

There will be more updates in the art department, and then New Game+ will be just around the corner!

Stay tuned! Until we meet again.

notes.content:

Hey factory workers!

This update's main feature is Trade Relays: these are Trade Ports' younger siblings.

They appear closer to the center of the map, and are available earlier on the research tree. Our goal was to provide more alternative options for getting more advanced goods at the earlier stages of the game, along with providing an opportunity for the players to get acquainted with trading mechanics earlier on.

Oh, and as opposed to Trade Ports, Trade Relays can be removed with Dynamite, if you don't need them and/or they interrupt your factory-building plans.

notes.title: KOTOVOD Workshop is now open! - Major Update, v0.26.168
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/d0fbb971a74e4f71aa2401365aa81c94f954f982.png[/img]

Hey factory builders!

[h2]Steam Workshop (Beta) Now Supported[/h2]
Learning Factory is a game developed in close contact with the community, so support for mods was in our plans from the very beginning. An option to create a custom scenario and/or share a generated map with your fellow factory builder was in the game for some time now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/e260411ab11e41f5d28d2e07842aa8b7ce5bee39.png[/img]

Today we're finally bringing all those features under one comfortable umbrella of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1150090/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url], so all the players could have access to them. But what's also cool is that you can share your work with just a couple of clicks!

At the moment, the following kinds of mods are available:
[list]
[*] Sharing of Ruins: pre-made parts of map that might appear upon generation of a map can be shared from Map editor
[*] Sharing your Factory is available at any time in the game, just press 'Esc' and find the respective button
[*] Sharing a Blueprint: select a Blueprint in the Blueprint Library ('B' by default), click 'Details' and share your Blueprint to the Workshop from there
[*] Sharing a map seed: available from map generating screen in the Freeplay mode
[/list]
You can read the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3141284038][b]detailed instructions in our official guide[/b][/url]

We have added a small selection of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=1150090&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems]mods of our own[/url] (you can run around that goofy Factory that we use for making screenshots, among other things), and the rest is up to you!

This is, of course, not the Learning Factory's Workshop final form (hence the 'Beta' subheading). At this point, we've focused on adding stuff that can be easily crafted and uploaded from the game, but we've got more plans!

And if you're looking for some hardcore modding action, like changing game assets, adding/modifying item recipes and making new types of cats - come to our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url], let's discuss it like serious people!

[b]Note:[/b] Workshop is not supported for Mac users at this time, but you can download a mod and paste it to your Local mods folder (located in Learning Factory folder, by your saved game files).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/60860557cf61d1c219885a80847fd61ed8616c8f.png[/img]

[h2]v0.26.168 Released![/h2]
[list]
[*] New upgrade for Storage units: underground Storage
[*] Regular Storage redesigned as well, now with visible stacking points
[*] Re-rendered Apple Collector
[*] Re-rendered Box Office
[*] Animated Dredge
[*] Animated Pillow Maker
[*] 2 new articles in the Wiki, explaining the mechanics of terraforming and tending to Martian plants
[*] Catopia Milestones bonuses re-balanced

[*] If a Legendary cat has a 5+ Loyalty level, it will request High Quality (++) items (suggested by [i]Zydox79[/i])
[*] Sorting by item categories is now available in the Backpack
[*] Middle mouse button now serves as an alternative input for the 'Q' button (suggested by [i]Brewski-Casegod[/i])
[*] Improved Map/Scenario editor
[*] New interface for Docks menu, feedback form, Zeppelin menu, Territory purchase menu, the inventory, and the 'Esc' menu windows
[*] The variety of sounds increased greatly
[*] In Freeplay mode, you can now play Story content on a random map (and this is the default option now)
[*] Translations updated: German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Italian, Spanish (LatAm), Polish, Portuguese (Brazil)
[*] Added ChatGPT-made translations for all Steam languages, community localizations are still available
[*] Bug fixes (kudos to [i]bloom16night[/i], [i]Lord Neodym[/i])
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/b70d1d346bec7426eac50403c9d4bcb6465935ca.png[/img]

Please don't forget to [b]add Learning Factory to your wishlist[/b], it's very important for us, and brings the 1.0 release closer:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/f75a0f61a8184858c3a22e9a12a9005714d7a799.gif[/img]

[h2]Re: Factory[/h2]

[i]In this section of patch notes, we answer the question from community that were submitted via the in-game feedback form and/or seemed especially interesting to us, You can always contact us directly in the comments or join our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url][/i]

[b]Q:[/b] "When clicking on a catopia shuttle part, it would be nice if the inventory opened instead of closed (the part where you have to drop off 100 vitamins and so on)" [i]-Zydox79[/i]
[b]A:[/b] The dedicated interface for providing items to the Ark modules is part of our plan already, it will make its' way to the game later on.

[b]Q:[/b] "I wish I could use lava bridge for water as well. This would increase comfort while building underground as I can use the lava bridge for both obstacles.
Maybe a renaming of ""bridge"" to ""wood bridge"" and ""lava bridge"" to ""stone bridge"" will keep the immersion.
That a wooden bridge does not fit for crossing lava might be somthing which cats with their much better brain find obvious and could be used for some of the joys of the game :)" [i]-Lord Neodym[/i]
[b]A:[/b] Terraforming could definitely used some improvements in the code, but that's not one of our immediate tasks for now... As for the naming, you have the point, but there's certain logics in the way those items are named as they are now. The name must explain the purpose of the item at the first time a player stumbles upon it, so adding another word to the name would make it harder to comprehend.
Subsequently, the word 'Lava' in the name points where to place a bridge; before we had it there, many players would try placing them on the water instead. So, to state it again, your suggestion does make sense, but could ruin UX for some of the players.

[b]Q:[/b] "It would be nice if ML training automatically stops when ""trained into stability"". I received a message ""ML model trained into stability"" and another, that it should be 20% more effective as the current one. But upon reaching the shop with the models, the new one (Linear Regression: 22) has a far worse error rate of 3.xx in compare to the previous used one of 1.18 (Linear Regression: 21)." [i]-Lord Neodym[/i]
[b]A:[/b] If a model would automatically stop after trained into stability, it could lead to a situation when the data changes, and the model quality will start degrading over time, as it had stopped learning. You can put any model on hold manually though!

[b]Q:[/b] "I wish building configuration would be copied into blueprints as well. If I copy a building via Q key and have at least one in my inventory, all settings get copied to ne new building. If I need to place a blueprint and craft it afterwards via quick build (J) the building configuration is at default. Now I need a second step to copy the configuration manually."[i]-Lord Neodym[/i]
[b]A:[/b] We'll definitely add this one to the game, thanks!

[b]Q:[/b] "For the ""Balanced Merger"" it is stated, that it will evenly merge two lines. This is only true as long as both lines are packed. As soon as at one of the lines items are missing, it will pull fully from the remaining line. This can be ssen at my Cat Foot production. As long as enough fish was available, everything went well. But as fish supply is too low, all factories are now backed with enough Catnip Algae. But fish will never get resupplied due to the inbalance happen before. It would be great if the Balanced Merger requires even inputs waiting if one line is empty. Thx4Reading and this awesome game :)" [i]-Lord Neodym[/i]
[b]A:[/b] We might have to specify Merger's description, as it was intended for situations different from what you described. We'll think of introducing other kind(s) of Merger, but we do not have plans for introducing another building for a task as narrow as that, unfortunately.

notes.title: Next Stop: v1.0 - Learning Factory Dev Diaries, January 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/f78ad54b9993510d2bfd6080336a621ea9835c56.png[/img]

We'd like to say we've been chilling and relaxing during the Holidays, and we were, really! But somehow, we have managed to add a whole new mode for Learning Factory in the meantime… Yeah, apparently that's how we roll. But first, let's take a moment and review the most important transformations the game was going through in that turbulent year of 2023…

Let's start with a quick recap from the past couple of years… It almost seems like we're playing a different game every year, huh?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/531e5b780e49dd4e63e0a424da26ba74d5c53ff8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/cf8a01f1092975574cb313ee8dd35f49dc41411b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/b1466afc1ffa27d210c3060375b1e8c105b305bd.png[/img]

Originally, our plans were to release Learning Factory into 1.0 version last year. Well, it turned out that the game grew way bigger than we were contemplating back in 2021… But we just couldn't leave our players hanging, especially those brave factory builders with 100+ hours of Learning Factory on their accounts.

That's why we made a huge leap in mid-December, releasing a major update adding the end game part to Learning Factory. That's right, the secret to Catopia is officially out there for you to research your way to. But that's not the end of the game: after you discover a secret of making all cats (and, subsequently, other living beings) in the Universe happy, you'll be honored with a quest to plan and launch an interstellar mission, spreading the catisfaction all over the outer space!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/69bba4a9d91adb6fff652de698f8d9f2f682985e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/690f56a4747e680cfc0ee50c15a096800b915b72.png[/img]

Naturally, you would need to equip your ‘meowthership’ (a.k.a. Catopia Ark) with the finest items from your Factory, because outer space cats deserve all the best! The end game mechanics are far from being final, we still have some ideas for that part, so stay tuned for more news!

We hope that from now on thigs you do on the Factory make sense, but do they though? Come to our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Dicord server[/url] to let us know, it's important for us to make the Learning Factory experience wholesome for you!

The next hero of today's diary wears no cape. You may even not notice it for some time, until you find yourself in its modern and comforting embrace! We're talking about the game's interface, if course: it's going through a massive renovation right now, which is part of our epic pre-release quest of polishing the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/608e11656b92ae3bb89972f34083059a9d81dda2.png[/img]

More changes to this aspect of the game are happening at this very moment, and will be featured in the next updates! And any feedback from you is always welcome, too.

This last year was full of changes that do not sound very impressive in text, but do make a big difference, especially when they all come together! To save you some time, let's review the most prominent improvements around Learning Factory in 2023:

[list]
[*] All items (included, but not limited to Quality and High Quality items) were re-rendered and now feature their own unique looks
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/b793d556086c270d2a08b6ff38cd1b555a1a8e26.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/71542d47a0eb816e1a4291112813f138d377e1ea.png[/img]
[*] Most buildings are/were going through the process of re-rendering, too, which implies higher quality animations, shadows for each and every building, and higher quality graphics in general
[*] The Underground level of the game finally become a full-fledged part of your Factory, where mmysterious Neon Cotton and Underground Algae grow, metals are mined and smelted, and whatnot! Since you'll probably get to spend way more time over there, the Undergound graphics was re-done, too:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/70073d5b654f6d773f8d10edd7d31662ae83dd3b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/b0b3397d7a8b459da1cf765e3f1413fcd371848c.png[/img]
[*] Blueprints are finally there, helping you plan your Factory campus in many exciting ways
[*] 20+ new buildings made its way into the game, including Chillout Space, Teleports and Schrodinger's Chamber for cloning cats
[*] Cat Zeppelins: yet another revolution in Factory logistics - they tranfer cats, and also shaped like cats - as seen in ‘My Neigbor Totoro’, but maybe a bit less weird
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/9165c9fa8811abda233f8450900382cd2c86186e.gif[/img]
[*] Alternate campaign map, with more challenging watery landscape
[*] The great crafting rebalancing occured: in short, it is stimulating you to produce higher quality items in the later parts of the game
[/list]
Of course, there were more changes, big and small: you can read about them (along with other stories) in our [url=https://ludenio.substack.com]blog[/url].

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
If you're asking yourself “Are they done there, finally?”, - the answer is strictly negative: the next update will be out in a couple of days, and it's going to be yet another major update! With some new animations, undergound Storages, many QoL improvements, and something very special. A little teaser: it starts with an “S-”, and ends with “-team Workshop support”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/643786d7be3b923c70bed483a331e1c52f497935.gif[/img]

Seriously though, we're running out of points to check on Learning Factory roadmap, and that means a lot of boring, steady work, preparing the game to the long-awaited 1.0 release.

And of course, none of this would be possible without you, the players! Thank you dearly for being with us, sharing your insights, opinions and suggestions: we take our players’ advice seriously here at Luden.io, and many features in the game are suggested by our community!

Come join us: this year promises to be especially interesting for Learning Factory! See you in the next edition of these Diaries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/643786d7be3b923c70bed483a331e1c52f497935.gif[/img]

[h3]Re: Factory[/h3]
[b]Q:[/b] "It's been a long time since I saw any wild growth in my world, trees or cotton spreading... is that intentional or is something broken? ()" -([i]Zydox79[/i])
[b]A:[/b] New plants stop emerging after 50% of the map is occupied.

[b]Q:[/b] "I don't get cats to enter Schrodinger's chamber, they just stand outside looking... I had the same issue before the patch as well... One cat went in and got cloned but after that no other cats wants to get cloned... I think you might need to work on education for the cats so that they aren't scared of quantum physics..." -([i]Zydox79[/i])
[b]A:[/b] It seems that you just got lucky with that first cat: normally cats can't be dragged into a service/tasting building or a Boutique. Instead, there's a chance that they decide to stroll into one of those buildings by themselves.

[b]Q:[/b] "肥料生产效率能高点吗，或者按照按照生效时间也可以呀，我现在使用大量的地块来生产苹果制作肥料，如果想要缩小地块，就只能使用肥料来加速苹果再生时间，但是就会导致我的肥料越来越少，无法使用在其他地方，玩到现在发现目前再生时间较长只有仙人掌，感觉其他的使用肥料来再生是非常吃亏的
Can the efficiency of fertilizer production be improved, or alternatively, can it be based on the effective time? Currently, I use a large number of plots to produce apples for making fertilizer. If I want to reduce the number of plots, I have to use fertilizer to speed up the regeneration time of apples. However, this leads to a shortage of fertilizer, making it unavailable for use elsewhere. As I progress in the game, I've noticed that the only plant with a longer regeneration time is the cactus. Using fertilizer for other plants seems to be a significant disadvantage." -([i]mezese[/i])
[b]A:[/b] There're many ways to boost the overall efficiency of plants' growth and harvesting at the end of the Research Tree. If you want to save Apple Boxes, you can also use an alternate recipe to produce Fertilizer from Fish and Milk. Make sure the tiles for growing Apple Trees are of 100% efficiency, too. But we do not have plans to add modifiers for base Fertilizer efficiency: it's up to you to decide which plants to fertilize to maximize the efficiency of production, it's part of the gameplay. We'll think of how to make it more comprehensive in this case in future updates!

notes.title: One Giant Leap for Felinekind - Learning Factory Dev Diaries, December 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/47ae95552224d180adf7da183132b8ff8d7fcaad.png[/img]

Hey factory workers!

Do you know what Learning Factory and black holes have in common? The game is sucking out our time and attention, just like a black hole is consuming the very fiber of the Universe around it. But most importantly: black holes are very heavy and condensed - the same way as Learning Factory is becoming a more complex and concentrated game with each update. Especially now, when the 1.0 release is just around the corner. Here, let us show you!

A question that we asked ourselves more than once in these diaries: what is Catopia? The answer is out there, but it is so deep and intricate, that human minds of the first half of the XXI century cannot contemplate it. Cats of the future know what Catopia is, but they wouldn't bother explaining it to inferior food bringers (that would be us, fellow human reader). 

All we know is whenever cats’ needs are met, they reach a superior state of being in total satisfaction, and start feeling a sudden urge to make other cats happier (which is not what cats normally do). So don't bother yourself with [i]what[/i] is Catopia, and focus on [i]how[/i] can you spread it around the Universe! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/ac8387fe0bd9c9480e40d4dd70803c7a6c7897ab.jpg[/img]

Apparently, it implies building and equipping an expeditionary space ship (codenamed ‘Catopia Ark’), and send a mission to the stars and other feline worlds, where your enlightened cats will teach their bretheren the secret of living in abundance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/497c60ec1e8ddcc0708fdc8ac58f884e3b5d9094.jpg[/img]

The ship will consist of several blocks. Each needs to be researched and built separately, and then packed with goods and crew members:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/68fcc9f799731d87b18d50a4f9029d475a65cd1d.jpg[/img]

Building one of those ships will be the formal ending of the game, but it's not the story finale, it's just the base for it: we've got some ideas on how to expand it. And of course, the final story comics is still to be drawn - those who played games in the 90s know that no decent game ends without a cartoon or comics in the end!

But generally, it's safe to say, that after this update is released, Learning Factory will be a complete game, one that you can play from the tutorial to the credits! Hooray? Hooray indeed!

Let's make some noise to celebrate: another big leap for us towards the release is giving voice to Dr. Katz. It wasn't part of the initial development plan, to be honest, but we experimented internally with AI-generated voice, and decided that it suits the game very well, while also helping highlight key events.

So we have partnered with the very talented actor [url=https://twitter.com/KeybladeAli]Ali Gohar[/url], who has done a great job impersonating a mad feline scientist:

[previewyoutube=x5koSUdS0ow;full][/previewyoutube]

These takes above are work in progress, though at least some of them will likely make it into the game. Our main reference was one very famous classic sci-fi character. Could you guess who it was? Let us know your best guess in the comments!

Speaking of content: some minor changes and new mechanics will continue emerging in the game - it's time for some fine tuning! In the last update, for example, we've added a bunch of new recipes and finally introduced the map-wide grid for more convenient building placement:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/ceffb7123a80a33d7458b909fa31bb3bf2ebc9f7.png[/img]

We also introduced a short-ranged teleport for items (known as Telemanipulator):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/16f591bf6e621268679984d2f542501030130303.jpg[/img]

…along with an upgrade for Cat Gate that allows you to get rid of unused items, donating it to random cats of the Universe:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/c10c1893d3229a8f4a425e5b886ba1be79f434e2.jpg[/img]

More perky little stuff like that will likely appear in the game, but it's not going to happen before we're done with re-renderig buildings and updating the game's interface. The latter will also make a partial appear in the upcoming update, here's a little teaser for you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/5a344faffadaf7dbecbf6301c41f0e3f6750c6ea.jpg[/img]

A (technical) story finale, new interface, and some voiceover - Learning Factory is making a huge leap towards its final form this December!

Stay tuned next week for the last major Learning Factory update of the year. We’ll return to you with the next edition of these diaries in 2024, to recap all the wonderful changes that happened at Learning Factory in the past year. Happy Holidays! Come celebrate this epic year in video games industry with us on our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url]!
