notes.title: Polishing Mars - Learning Factory Dev Diaries, November 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/35698a70fec2333322ca1455383d8cea6aa80ab4.png[/img]

Hey engineers!

We found ourselves in a situation a couple of days ago: apparently, all the game’s mechanics are in place. Of course, there’s still a lot to do in UI/UX, QoL (and other fancy game dev abbreviations), and tons of tasks in the art department. There’s one big part of the game to be shaped and implemented (more on that below), but the big stuff is in place!

If you thought that means there won't be new content, you've probably joined us just recently: those following us these years know that we're adding new stuff to our games all the time. 

It's just at this stage of the game all of our own ideas are pretty much there, so we're relying on stuff based on the feedback from our community. Take this bunch of brand new engineer's little helpers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/1f74213d6cc3b187d571c10da226b7bd22b90274.png[/img]

The names are self-explanatory (hopefully). According to our players, those become extremely handy in the late stages of the game, when factory-building gets real.

These beautiful creatures will help you in further de-spaghettifying your Factory:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/1359f2e4dac3e18ceb4648c21539fb54ff7a6632.png[/img]

If you have an idea for a building of your own (or just want to chat with us and like-minded devs), we're happy to lend you our eyes and ears on our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url]!

The last couple updates brought lots of smaller alterations here and there, which change the game quite a lot. Perhaps, one of the most prominent experiments of the month was re-balancing our terraforming system. As you might know, tiles differ not only by visuals, but also by efficiency/fertility level. It influences the rate of growth for plants, as well as the work of certain buildings. 

For example, if you'd place a Fishing Spot, you can hover upon a tile in its’ operating area to spot the difference:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/08b69909b9162e52da268db75db5a7d35251f7ca.png[/img]

Previously, the way to maximize the efficiency of tiles was to replace them with handcrafted tiles. A side effect of that was that some players would fill the whole map with those tiles. While we're totally ok with such style of play, we'd like the players to experiment some more, trying to overcome the natural obstacles of the landscape - at least, in the early stages of the game. 

Hence the experiment: researching terraforming tiles now costs more than before (while the price of production of tiles themselves remains the same). At the same time, we've introduced another type of Fertilizer that helps maximize the efficiency of any tile, without changing its type. It becomes available early in the game, giving you the opportunity to maximize your tile-based production before you delve into intense terraforming. And, as always, your feedback on this risky enterprise of ours is very welcome!

While we're speaking about tiles: we have re-rendered some stuff (again; will do much more), including, but not limited to, the Rafts:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/20eefe5b44087dd0749aa43860b9dc9e8cfb4075.png[/img]

And look at those juicy red mutant Apple Trees from Mars (along with Fertilizer Sprinkler in action):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/250c4191c9bd9282b5432f15ba60be3c2fe64f8b.png[/img]

We've improved the tutorial. We've added chatGPT-made translations (in addition to commuity-made translations) for unofficial languages. We've added some sounds for cats and their surroundings. We've made a whole new section in the Statistics tab, where the data is displayed in the form of tables:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/bf736e1e49488ed0e1990a4c1358fdedd07fed37.png[/img]

Heck, we made dozens of changes here and there, big and small! Our patch notes are becoming longer with each update we release. All these efforts serve but one purpose: achieving Catopia. And it is closer than it seems.

[h3]How to Catopia[/h3]

We have started contemplating Catopia almost a year ago. It was the goal of the game from the very beginning but we could not decide what it is, exactly. Until recently, that is.

Catopia milestone can already be reached on the Research Tree, and provide a nice bonus for those who make it. However, the endgame part of Learning Factory is still in development. 

But today we're proud to announce, that we have recently agreed on the mechanics, along with the genral concept for establishing the perfect cat society! And it will emerge in the game sooner than you might think.

In the meantime, here's a little teaser image (that we have randomly found on the web to use as an internal reference):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/9055e5e3ee9b28bf06c348b0528e3fad0854f718.jpg[/img]

If it hardly makes sense or does not look epic enough, our only advice: just you wait!

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]

Catopia, apparently! But wait, there's more! Our artist Sergei has freed up some time to make Learning Factory UI shine! Here are some sketches:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/5ae8984b3b4e886d9be6d7fa5b542049483b3d86.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/e2be70e32e395f5355c0b9d8fb7c7a9790a03d74.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/1ca02835e8f3ff0531cf420aaf077d0a33cd8500.jpg[/img]

Just to make clear: those were already discarded, and won't make it into the final game. But it does instantly change the look of Learning Factory, don't you think?

And of course, next month there will be polishing, more polishing, and then some.

Hear the smell? It's the smell of the year 2024 coming our way. It's the smell of upcoming Learning Factory release! See you next month, and don't forget to pet your cat on a regular basis!

notes.title: Community Highlight: What Cats Want? (Guide)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/2240199525ce07bd483dbb4f02ea48f0d7fd169d.png[/img]

Sure, Learning Factory is a relaxing base-building game, but there're actually a lot of stuff happening under the cape! 

The cats that arrive at Learning Factory are complicated beasts, with their own shopping goals, spontaneous desires, loyalty to your brand, and even overall life satisfaction levels. 

Understanding the interactions between these parameters is pivotal for maximizing your profits, and, subsequently, funding your research to ensure the creation of Catopia!

Now, there's a series of in-game wiki articles explaining all that, but our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord community[/url] member [i]Trichouette[/i] has done an even better job creating an impressive compendium of cats' shopping lists:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3054546443][b]'Understanding cats' shopping list' - Read the Guide[/b][/url], and you will learn about:

[list]
[*] Purchase types
[*] Pyramid purchases and Personal Satisfaction Pyramid
[*] Specialized purchases and Specialized Categories
[*] Upsale purchases
[*] Testing booths
[*] Loyalty and Quality
[*] Hype
[*] Machine Learning
[/list]
The author was consulting with us while working on the guide, so consider it dev approved.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

If you want to discuss this guide (or maybe consult with us while you're making your own?), or discuss anything Learning Factory-related - the best place to do so would be our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url]. But any way of reaching us and letting us know what you think of the game works for us, so don't be a stranger!

notes.title: How to Catopia - New Update, v0.24.155
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/6f8249117d977463d364785114e4e032118c348d.png[/img]

Hey engineers! The grand game polishing has officially begun, but that doesn't mean we won't be adding new awesome content (quite the contrary, actually!). But first, we'd like to talk to you about an experiment we made...

[h2]Experimental Terraforming Re-Balance[/h2]
As you might now, default tiles of the game have random efficiency distribution. It can affect growth of plants and the efficiency of some buildings. 

Previously, the best way to maximize a tile's potential was to replace it with a manually crafted tile. This update brings an option to do it with a special kind of Fertilizer (see below). It becomes available early in the game, but to compensate it, we have increased the cost of research for terraforming tiles (the production costs of tiles, once researched, remains the same)

Our idea is to motivate players to interact with two default maps' landscapes, making use of the land they get on the default map and finding creative solutions for numerous watery obstacles on the alternate map. 

This idea makes sense to us, but you'll be the ones playing it, so we encourage you to check this part of the game out and let us know:

Is it a 'yay' or 'nay' for you? Share your thoughts in the comments below, or drop us a line on [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url], or use the built-in feedback form in the game

[h2]v0.24.155 Released![/h2]

[h3]New Buildings && Content[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/502e03a512124e3799073ea88d2d1674c0f8aa90.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New building: Raft Crafter automatically makes Rafts for you (suggested by [i]Trichouette[/i]) +an upgrade for making Lava Rafts
[*] New item: Surface Fertilizer is a consumable that maximizes the efficiency of any tile without changing its' type (suggested by [i]Trichouette[/i])
[*] Added an option to select origin of cats coming through regular Cat Gates - the higher the Hype, the more the chance to attract a cat from selected origin instead of regular passerby cat; if this happens, the cat arrived will have +1 Loyalty level
[*] The final Catopia milestone can now be unlocked on the progress bar of the Research Tree: it increses the Hype but does not unlock endgame gameplay yet
[*] The Second Prototype milestone now unlocks (spontaneous) 'Cats' Ascension', which provides a chance for cats to arrive at the Factory with increased Loyalty, depending on Hype level
[/list]
[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Re-rendered Apple Trees
[*] Re-rendered Metal Drill
[*] Re-rendered Lumber Mill
[*] Re-rendered Box Maker
[*] Re-rendered Concrete flooring
[*] Re-rendered Apple Boxes
[*] Re-rendered Rafts
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/20eefe5b44087dd0749aa43860b9dc9e8cfb4075.png[/img]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] The progress in achieving the next milestone is now visible on the Monument
[*] Upgrade allowing to harvest Juicy Cacti with Lumber Mills now adds another recipe with increased efficiency
[*] New upgrade for Compost Machine, allowing it to craft Surface Fertilizers
[*] Upgrade unlock requirement to advertise items to cats can now be fulfilled via Advertising Cat Gates, too (previously it was only possible in service/tasting buildings)
[*] Nanoproduction infinite research project now increases manual work speed too
[*] Selected infinite researches slightly buffed
[*] Crafting a Growing Deep Algae now requires less resources in general, but requires Quality (+) Catnip Algae
[*] Research cost of all tiles for terraforming was increased to balance the new tile-improving mechanics
[*] Increased amount of terraforming tiles given as reward for fulfilling Dr. Katz's requests; the frequency of such awards was increased as well
[*] Dormitory expansion costs slightly decreased
[*] Cats with upsale requests and mass purchasing cats now appear even further on in the game
[*] Eco Dynamite removed from the game (temporarily)
[*] Changed progress bar on the Research Tree, some milestones moved
[*] Added a new quest after Tutorial, that prompts further research and brings monetary reward
[*] Added new achievement: conduct 100 researches
[*] Added another secret achievement
[/list]
[h3]QoL && Interface
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an option to customize the looks of cat researchers in Labs (suggested by[i] Cat (the Black)[/i])
[*] Tooltip for Dynaminte now shows countdown before explosion
[*] 'Collect All' feature works faster
[*] Improved tutorial
[*] Hotkeys on numeric keyboard keys now summon a Blueprint of a building, if it is not crafted
[*] Wiki articles now clearly display the category of items (suggested by [i]ChromatiChicken[/i])
[*] Added an event when an empty hotkey is activated, along with a hint on assigning it
[*] Added statistics: cat knowledge from satisfied cats
[*] The panel on top of the screen now displays the recent amount of cat knowledge points gained from satisfied cats
[*] Improved tooptips 
[*] Added an option to search for research categories on the Research Tree, clicking on a category icon highlights relevant research projects
[*] More convenient sorting in Statistics tab
[*] Added a search field to Zeppelin Routes tab
[*] Story comic strips can now be leafed through
[*] Added chatGPT translation for the French language
[*] Lots of copywriting improvements
[/list]
[h3]Techie Stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated engine version
[*] Performance optimization
[*] Bug fixes (kudos to [i]squibbons, HelDoRe, squibs, bloom16night[/i])
[*] Copying and pasting configs now with improved visual effect
[*] UI/UX improvements
[/list]
[h3]Re: Factory[/h3]
In this section, we're reacting to your bug reports and feedback sent through the in-game report form:

[i]Re: Wayne[/i]

notes.title: Stage 4 Complete - Major Update, v0.24.151
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/4790924b1487cd229b04e6b9d9a92240b532148f.png[/img]

Hey engineers! And congratulations to you, as this update marks Early Access Stage 4 as complete! We've been really focused on updating the visuals in the past couple of monts, so this update is something new.

On one hand, we've pushed it hard to make some of the game's mechanics more comprehensive. On the other hand, we've made crafting more complex and challenging for more intense brain stimulation! 

[h2]v0.24.151 Released! [/h2]

[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] New story comics - the origin story of how our nameless protagonist met their cat (named Cat), under rather rainy circumstances. Hopefully, this story will motivate you to care about cats (in-game, or real-life) even more
[*] New theme for the main menu
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/1cac536915102f95103cdd01ac0eb8a3123dd1b2.png[/img]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Global crafting rebalancing (see below)
[*] Added a whole new Wiki section explaining complicated in-game mechanics: Loyalty, Mass purchases, Upselling, Machine Learning, Data Quality, Research, Hype, Satisfaction Pyramid, and Legendary cats
[*] Legendary cats request Quality (+) or better items from now on
[*] Legendary cats are now classified as Cats with lvl 3 Loyalty
[*] Cats with Loytalty lvl 5+ now request High Quality (++) items
[*] Cats with Loyalty lvl 3-4 now request Quality (+) items
[*] Improved tutorial
[*] Square Cardboard Space Signal Emitter research project now provides a higher chance of summoning a legendary cat
[*] During Shopaholic Invasion, cats with higher Loyalty levels may arrive, depending on Hype
[*] Shopaholic Invasion duration increases along with your Hype level
[*] New events, aimed to give the players better control over the Factory
[*] Increased cat knowledge points reward for fulfilling Dr Katz's requests
[*] Increased bonus cat knowledge points for serving legendary cats
[*] 3 new perks for cat researchers
[*] New perk for Dr Katz
[*] Random cats can get generated with the 'Genius' perk (fromerly available only to Dr Katz)
[*] Research efficiency calculating mechanics for cat researchers slightly changed (may result in altered research time for hired researchers in existing saved games)
[*] Selling items of quality gives a bigger boost to Loyalty
[*] Upgrading Loom increases its' speed by 5 ticks instead of 2
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/1d45c62f7fd820cf20dc6e6910813a2bd9269321.png[/img]
[h3]QoL & Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added stats showing tips left by each cat type
[*] Added stats showing sales income from each cat type
[*] Added stats showing total income from each cat type
[*] Approximate research cost now shown under each research project
[*] Added an option to clear cache in the settings, in case your minimap seems to be displayed incorrectly
[*] Map name is now displayed for every saved game (starting from this version)
[*] Choosing to involve incompetent researches into research projects results in 4x experience boost for those researchers
[*] Upper panel now displays the amount of money spent on research and ads
[*] Added an option to disable tutorial and instantly get a starting pack of buildings, if campaign is not launched for the first time
[*] Machine learning models now display a warning if there's no Store/Boutique connected to a cluster
[*] If your system language is not officially supported by the game, you'll get a warning and a suggestion to switch into English, when launching the game for the first time
[*] Added partial translation into the German language by ChatGPT (community translation is still there, too)
[*] Improved tooltips
[*] Improved, more stable Twitch integration
[*] New achievement
[/list]
[h3]Techie Stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated credits
[*] UI/UX fixes
[*] Bug fixes (kudos to [i]CheeseAndChocolate[/i], [i]MarcusZ[/i], [i]squibbons[/i], [i]bloom16night[/i])
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/1b63ff3912a58b3b6cee39fd584d1641b045879a.png[/img]
[h3]Rebalancing Crafting Costs[/h3]
Previously, most buildings would require regular quality items for crafting. With this update, more complex items will be required for crafting, as you progress through the resarch tree:

[list]
[*] Crafting T-shaped Splitters requires Quality (+) Iron
[*] Crafting Quad Splitter requires Quality (+) Iron
[*] Crafting Awesome Golden Statue requires Quality (+) Gold
[*] Crafting Eco Dynamite requires Quality (+) Catnip Algae 
[*] Crafting Hard Rock Dynamite requires Quality (+) Catnip Juice
[*] Crafting all kinds of Long conditional Manipulators (except for Cat Manipulator) require Quality (+) Iron and Quality (+) Copper
[*] Crafting Long Quality Manipulator requires Quality (+) Concrete instead of Copper
[*] Crafting Two-Item Dock requires Quality (+) Concrete
[*] Crafting Pawssenger Dock now requires Quality (+) Boxes
[*] Crafting Exit Cat Gate now requires Quality (+) Copper
[*] Crafting Inventory Teleport now requires Quality (+) Copper and Concrete
[*] Crafting Teleport now requires Quality (+) Concrete
[*] Crafting Logistics Assembler now requires Quality (+) Iron
[*] Crafting Cable Crafter now requires Quality (+) Iron
[*] Crafting Soil Silo now requires Quality (+) Wood
[*] Crafting Enriched Soil Silo now requires Quality (+) Concrete
[*] Crafting Apple Collector now requires Quality (+) Wood
[*] Crafting Fishing Pier now requires Quality (+) Wood instead of Iron
[*] Crafting Fish Maker now requires Quality (+) Fish
[*] Crafting Algae Harvester now requires Quality (+) Iron and Quality (+) Copper
[*] Crafting Catnip Juice Brewery now requires Quality (+) Wood
[*] Crafting Smoothie Mixer now requires Quality (+) Concrete
[*] Crafting Brew Intensifier now requires Quality (+) Iron
[*] Crafting Awesome Statue now requires Quality (+) Wood, Quality (+) Iron, and Quality (+) Concrete
[*] Crafting Vitamin Maker now requires Quality (+) Copper
[*] Crafting Geothermal Furnace now requires Quality (+) Concrete, and also 2 Drills instead of 2 Furnaces
[*] Crafting Omnimill now requires Quality (+) Concrete and Quality (+) Catnip Juice
[*] Crafting Wohlwill Purifier now requires Batteries and Quality (+) Catnip Juice
[*] Crafting Dredge now requires  Quality (+) Concrete
[*] Crafting Cat Food Maker now requires  Quality (+) Wood
[*] Crafting Bubble Gum Mixer now requires Quality (+) Copper and Cotton
[*] Crafting Pillow Maker now requires Yarn Balls and Ropes
[*] Crafting Hammock Weaver now requires Quality (+) Rope
[*] Crafting Omniloom now requires Quality (+) Rope, Quality (+) Catnip Juice, Quality (+) Concrete, and High Quality (++) Iron
[*] Crafting Cat House Maker now requires Quality (+) Wood
[*] Crafting Bling Machine now requires Quality (+) Iron, and Gold
[*] Crafting Battery Maker now requires Quality (+) Concrete and Quality (+) Iron
[*] Crafting Tech Overcharger now requires Quality (+) Concrete
[*] Crafting Microchip Maker now requires Quality (+) Concrete, and Manipulators
[*] Crafting Quantum Tech Assembler now requires Quality (+) Concrete, and Quality (+) Lasers
[*] Crafting Schrodinger's Chamber now requires Quality (+) Boxes
[*] Crafting Neural Networks now requires Quality (+) Concrete
[*] Crafting Dynamite now requires Quality (+) Catnip Algae
[*] Crafting Laser Pointer Maker now requires Quality (+) Concrete, Quality (+) Iron and 1 Battery Maker, instead of 2
[*] Crafting Laser Collider now requires Quality (+) Concrete, Quality (+) Laser Pointer, and High Quality (++) Gold
[*] Decreased Cloth amount reauired for crafting Small Cargo Zeppelins
[*] Crafting Cargo Zeppelin now requires Quality (+) Cloth and Quality (+) Ropes
[*] Crafting all promotional/tasting buildings now require Quality (+) items
[*] Crafting Deep Water now requires Quality (+) Fish
[*] Crafting Concrete Flooring now requires Quality (+) Concrete
[*] Crafting Graphic Card Assembler now requires Quality (+) Concrete
[*] Crafting Land Digger now requires Quality (+) Iron
[/list]

So close to Catopia! Check out our EA roadmap:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/885af54d5473fc632f3df7904c4804d48ed35788.png[/img]

[b]A:[/b] This feature already exists in the game, make sure to research an upgrade for your Multitool!

notes.title: Top Secret Factory Cluster - New Update, v0.23.150
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/09af7e3de3d008813556836ecefd732c8770a220.png[/img]
Hey engineers,

This new update extends the game campaign, facilitates customization items' unlocks, and brings tons of usability improvements! Update and rejoice!

[h2]v0.23.150 Released![/h2]

[h3]Visuals, Sounds, New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] HALLOWEEN IS HERE + 3 new themed items for cats
[*] An alternative map for campaign: more intricate landscape, less reources, available to those who started playing the main campaign at least once
[*] Decreased prices for most customization items, some items can be unlocked for triggering certain in-game events
[*] New customization item: Shiny Down jacket, unlocked for mining Gold
[*] New customization item: Dr. Katz's friends fan club hat, unlcoked for satisfying 'Friendly cats' legendary cat
[*] Made it easier to notice that a new customization item was unlocked
[*] New music track for Jungle biome
[*] New music track for Tundra biome
[*] New Legendary cat
[*] Re-rendered Yarn Ball Maker
[*] Minor terraforming visuals upgrade
[*] Parts of holiday decorations can be toggled on and off in the settings (suggested by [i]Trichouette[/i])
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/3e3521cf3bc7be77f8ee98954ffa2f4c30fddf68.png[/img]

[h3]Buildings && Upgrades[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 upgrades for the Enriched Soil Silo, increasing the crafting limit (suggested by  [i]Евгений Ры́марев[/i])
[*] New upgrade for Soil Silo, allowing automatic crafting of Concrete Flooring
[*] New upgrade for the Roadside Boutique, adding an extra slot for goods
[*] Roadside Boutique logics redesigned: a connected machine learning model will always be working, and it is always possible to switch to your own price or sales mode
[*] A new recipe for the Milk Drill, one of the older recipes modified (suggested by [i]Ksetrat[/i])
[*] Crafting limit for Compost Machone increased from 500 to 5000
[*] Faster Concrete production in the desert requires 1 unit of Catnip Juice instead of 2
[/list]
[h3]New Hotkeys && Instruments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a hotkey for crafting a copy of a building when mouse cursor is over it ('U' by default); pressing 'Ctrl' + 'U' results in crafting up to 100 copies; 
[*] Pressing 'Ctrl' + 'U' or 'Ctrl' + click when hovering over a building on the building panel in the bottom part of the screen (suggested by [i]MarcusZ[/i])
[*] Pressing 'Ctrl' + 'open Backpack' while hovering over a building on the building panel opens the tab containing this building and select it, if possible (suggested by [i]MarcusZ[/i])
[*] Opening the Wiki while hovering over a building on the building panel opens the tab containing this building and select it, if possible
[*] Pipette tool can now work with the building panel
[*] Pressing 'Ctrl' + pipette hotkey on the building panel creates a Blueprint
[/list]
[h3]QoL && Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] Picking up all the Blueprints doesn't result in picking up all objects from the map anymore
[*] Added a timer indicating the time left before the next event starts
[*] Wiki articles show optimal biomes for growing plants (suggested by [i]Евгений Ры́марев[/i])
[*] Added an option to sort recipes in the Wiki (suggested by [i]MarcusZ[/i])
[*] It is no longer ppossible to change water tiles to ground tiles under Trade Routes
[*] Improved tutorial
[*] UI/UX fixes
[/list]
[h3]Techie Stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*] Performance optimization
[*] Performance optimization in zoomed out view
[*] Bug fixes (via [i]Евгений Ры́марев[/i], [i]LoadRunner[/i], [i]Ksetrat[/i], [i]MarcusZ[/i])
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/6f82df1c94a1125cf5ed1e01132355cae3741d94.png[/img]

[h2]Re: Factory[/h2]
We're planning to continue answering the question you send our way through the in-game feedback form!

[b]Q:[/b] 'pressingg tab to go to the underworld will let me pass the  barrier and let me walk on water, from what I have tested it needs to have cotton next to a slope and for some reason tabs puts me in the underworld water side.' -[i]Deadvite[/i]
[b]A: [/b]This is a known bug, and a mighty hard to fix one, too. Since it doesn't break the game, we have no immediate plans in looking into it, not before we finish tasks with higher priority

The next batch of questions is from our friend [i]MarcusZ[/i]

[b]Q:[/b] 'Missing german translation of "microchip" inside the wiki. Btw it is "Mikrochip".'
[b]A:[/b] Most of our current translations are community-based, you are very welcome to help us by making contributions to Learning Factory's [url=https://crowdin.com/project/learning-factory]Crowdin Project[/url].

[b]Q:[/b] 'I often use the map to find rare deposits like gold, milky iceberg and cactuses. Although color coded, these are difficult to see.
It would be helpful to:
- make Map a fullscreen window
- highlight choosable type of resource on the map (i.e flashing color)
- place/delete user defined marker(s)' 
[b]A:[/b] When we were working on the map, we didn't think that we'll need to add as many features suggested by our players. We might add some lenses in the future, and most likely will, but probably not all of those listed. In the meantime, you can enlarge the map to almost fill the screen, by pressing 'M' button twice.

[b]Q:[/b] 'My logarithmic learning model does not get training data, although it is connected. I already deleted/rebuild it. (See attached save where i am standing)'
[b]A:[/b] Logistic Regression is a dedicated ML model for Roadside Boutiqes, and must be connected to one in order to start collecting data.

[b]Q:[/b] 'Is the "Graphic Card Assembler" a scientific building by accident? It is a production building so I would expect it to be in the production category.'
[b]A:[/b] It's listed in both categories.

[b]Q:[/b] 'When I search for a blueprint, matching entries get highlighted, non-matching are grayed out. But I still have to scroll through the whole list. This is uncomfortable. 
I suggest to implement the filter to remove non-matching blueprints and use an X-Button to remove the filter and restore the list'
[b]A:[/b] Thanks for poiting that out, we're now thinking of optimal solution to this situation. Just removing non-matching Blueprints from the list might not be the best way to solve it but, again, we're working on it.

[b]Q:[/b] 'I reached a point where some cats have more then 5 wanted goods so that one shop per cat type cannot satisfy the need. I thought about reworking my factory layout to split the cats not by type but by good category. But this is also not working, because often cats want multiple products from multiple categories. Because i want to create an effective factory this is frustrating me.
So I suggest to implement a way to sort cats so that their need can be satisfied. My idea: When a cat wants multiple products they should be of one single category.'
[b]A:[/b] There're plenty of ways to satisfy all requests of a cat. Here's a brief list of things you can do:
[list]
[*] Research an upgrade increasing the number of slots for items in Cat Stores
[*] Sort cats by requests using respective Splitter/Manipulator: some cats are looking for multiple items from specific categories (they're called 'Specialized purchases' and can bee seen in the wiki), so it makes sense to separate them from the rest and send to dedicated Stores
[*] Sort cats by types using respective Splitter/Manipulator
[*] Use Specialized Smart Stores
[*] Use Advertising Cat Gates to attract cats of specific types/requests
[/list]

A friendly reminder: you can always chat with us directly on our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url]. We're using Discord for work, so you'll find many of us there most of the time, don't be a stranger!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory

Don't forget to follow Learning Factory on Steam to get the news about new updates as soon as they're out there

notes.content:

Hey engineers,

We're all finally back from all kinds of vacations, hooray! It's business as usual from now on: a shiny new update every 2 weeks. This one brings some new buildings, updated visuals, new music & much more:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a5a74ce3dbd833411fe61d0f986c73976fd904e4.png[/img]

[h3]v0.23.148 Released![/h3]
[list]
[*] New building: Tech Overcharger uses geothermal energy of Mars to produce High Quality Batteries and Laser Pointers
[*] New building: Laser Collider uses the power of laser to make Quality and High Quality Gems, and transmutate Iron to Copper, and vise versa
[*] Re-rendered Cotton Trees
[*] Re-rendered Trees & Fir Trees
[*] New music them for the notherrn biome
[*] Pressing 'Ctrl' + click on a building force places a Blueprint
[*] Saved game file size slightly decreased
[*] UI/UX improvements
[*] UI fixes
[*] Placing a Raft & removing it no longer maximizes the tile quality (via [i]Mzato[/i])
[*] You can no longer get achievements while playing in Guides mode
[*] Bug fixes (kudos to [i]Eugene Rymarev, Mzato[/i])
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/42f0bd20649f9ac4eb9444696d6f3c4a941d7782.png[/img]

We'd also like to comment on one of the messages we got via the in-game feedback form. This one is from [i]Marcus[/i]

[b]Q:[/b] "Saving blueprint bug: I want to save a two layer blueprint. My layout extends one row to the south more on sublevel than on surface. If I mark the area correctly (one extra row) on surface and press Ctrl+S the parts of that extra row were cut off. The same happens if I save while sublevel is active. Than the north part of the surface buildings is gone.
It seems, the selection is narrowed down to the visible buildings on active level. But it should contain the buildings inside the selection of both levels!"

[b]A: [/b]This is not a bug, we just can't know in advance whether a player wants to capture a blueprint with buildings from another layer inside all selection area or not (for example if it just convenient to select a bigger area). We will add an option for this selection in the future.

notes.title: Back to the Factory - Learning Factory Dev Diaries, August 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/14290194abb7cd0aac38111d016c6f75277f872f.png[/img]

Hey engineers!

As you probably remember, last month we said our (temporary) goodbyes for the next couple of weeks, since the vacation period was upon us. Was it this time of the year for you, too? Did you manage to catch some rest? Share your stories in the comments!

Our programmer/game designer Ivan rushed into the office straight from a distant forest, where he had been enjoying his hobby of LARPing (this time, he performed as a dunmer from the TES universe).

We were about to release just one update this month, but it grew to epic proportions. So even with almost everything ready - the code, the graphics, the copywriting, etc. - it took us some extra time to test and prepare everything. Of course, it was totally worth the while! Let's review the hottest new content first:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/39113b99cd64faf18336268517bb6cf6e75dbd43.png[/img]

Sergei the artist did a great job, providing us with a whole 3 new buildings, capable of producing top-quality Wood, Gold, and tech stuff. These late-game machines will provide a real challenge for the logistics genius inside you, for you will need to transfer exotic resources back and forth around the map.

Fun fact: Wolhwill Purifier is based on the actual process of refining gold to an amazing level of 99.999% purity. It is usually required for producing very expensive electronics, but if you feel like it, you can even recreate this process at home - if you have some pure gold, appropriate chemical equipment, along a handful of dangerous reagents. Science is fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8b54598f98b89ee872ba6f6783a89f4b3d9396c5.png[/img]

As for the Quantum Tech Assembler, it's just beautiful. And quantum. Quantum makes everything sound more scientific, as is widely known:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/9cd865ba4c92ee9b49cdfdac7dbda530f0656c90.png[/img]

And these two interesting subjects below are a product of some of our very productive discussions with the community. Some of you wanted underground floating cotton (is that still cotton at this point?). Sure, why not? And corner-shaped Splitters make total sense if you think about it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a69a3c70100c3e98ffbc6ace6eb7fb7e4587be8b.png[/img]

By the way, if you aren't on our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url] already, you're very welcome to join! Your feedback means an awful lot because that's how we learn how to make our games better!

[h3]The Great Rerender[/h3]

If you played Learning Factory, say, a year ago and decide to come visit it now, you might notice that some buildings have shadows. Some, but not all of them! This is because the process of polishing and rethinking the game's visuals is going on slowly. Steadily. The arrival of the coolest graphics in the world of cat factory-building games is imminent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/db79ad55dd624e7c2eb1007bbdcffbc5d534a233.png[/img]

Fun fact: with the last update we have finished a rather prolonged process of redesigning items. There were two main reasons for that: one - some items looked visually noisy when the camera was too far away from the ground, and the other one - since we introduced the quality of items, it only made sense to make all the items look unique.

Some other items are getting a facelift as well. Right now we're considering a new art for trees. Here's a work-in-progress screenshot of them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/607bb7cc69efd857b08bad49952feb79941a10a5.png[/img]

Several new buildings are in the works, too. We can't talk much about them now but their codenames are ‘Tech Overcharger’ and ‘Laser Infuser’. It is very probable (but not guaranteed) that you will see them in the next update, planned for September 5th:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a1c118fb915c1ba5f2076093e8aeacd148803245.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8726add5772323e7a0f5d19efe42e5dda3633ef7.jpg[/img]

You can follow our progress by checking out our Early Access Roadmap, which is updated regularly on Learning Factory's Steam page - just scroll down a little bit:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

(And if you haven't done so already, don't forget to add Learning Factory to your wishlist!)

Another month is ahead of us, another bunch of exciting news about Learning Factory will emerge in the next edition of these developer dairies. Stay awesome, and play some awesome games! Until we meet again.

P.S. A little bonus for those whore read it this far: here's a couple of photos of our devs’ cats:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8647179d31e781403c5428767d3b60fe23fc69af.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/3b9f80c770bc28f4471b45fb4ff3c133dc70845c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/eabf7ccae3ceedabf64974ca442b488438bbe771.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Major Update, v0.23.146: Quantum Hi-Tech
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/847d6829914c149632b5364f60790375c02b6e4e.png[/img]

Hey engineers! We're back from our summer vacation marathon, and how! This update doesn't need long introductions, it's big enough as it is!

[h1]v0.23.146 Released! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/9cd865ba4c92ee9b49cdfdac7dbda530f0656c90.png[/img]

[h2]Buildings & Plants[/h2]
[list]
[*] New building: Omnimill is capable of harvesting High Quality (++) Wood and Boxes
[*] New building: Wohlwill Purifier refines Gold into High Quality (++) Gold, also produces High Quality (++) Jewelry
[*] New building: Quantum Tech Assembler makes High Quality (++) Graphic Cards, Microchips, and Cat Vitamins
[*] New building: Transporter Crafter was renamed to Logistics Assembler: it can now also craft Splitters and Tunnels, and can be placed under the ground
[*] New item: Underwater Neon Cotton is an upgrade to regular Neon Cotton
[*] New building: Corner-shaped Splitter is an upgraded version of a regular Splitter ([i]suggested by Cat (the Black), Rex, Trichouette & others[/i])
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8b54598f98b89ee872ba6f6783a89f4b3d9396c5.png[/img]

[h2]Visuals & Sounds[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Cat Houses visuals
[*] New music & sounds - Tundra biome has its own tunes now!
[/list]

[h2]Upgrades & Recipes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upgrade for Logistics Assembler provides more new recipes
[*] New default recipe for crafting Vertical Cables in Cable Crafter
[*] New upgrade: a recipe for producing High Quality (++) Milk
[*] New alternate recipe for Milk added to Milk Drill by default
[*] New upgrade: increasing the limit of teleported items for Inventory Teleport ([i]suggested by busybeas[/i])
[*] New upgrade: allows underground placement for Concrete Mixers
[*] New recipe for crafting High Quality (++) Concrete from lava
[*] New default recipes for producing High Quality (++) Cotton
[*] Upgrading the Dormitory no longer requires Quality (+) Boxes until 6th slot is unlocked
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/39113b99cd64faf18336268517bb6cf6e75dbd43.png[/img]

[h2]Other Gameplay Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cats can now leave tips in Stores (except for the Roadside Boutique) that depends on their Loyalty levels
[*] 2 new Blueprints added to the Blueprint Library
[*] Improved efficiency of certain trade deals
[*] Added trade deals for buying and selling Milk, along with summoning cats for Milk
[*] Cost requirements in Advertising Cat Gate increased for most cases (and decreased for some other cases), now more depending on the Hype level
[*] More variable cat expectations for the ad budgets in Advertising Cat Gates
[*] Cotton Collector can harvest Underwater Neon Cotton underground
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a69a3c70100c3e98ffbc6ace6eb7fb7e4587be8b.png[/img]

[h2]QoL & Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] Quick saving is now available ('F10')
[*] Improved localization for in-game comics for unofficial languages 
[*] Optimization of saving game speed and saved game file size
[*] Improved Tutorial
[*] Performance optimization
[*] UI/UX improvements
[*] Improved recipes display in the Wiki, including recipes unlocked with upgrades
[*] Pressing ‘Ctrl’ + ‘F’ now focuses on the available search field
[*] Added an option to search for buildings on the bottom panel, activated by pressing ‘Ctrl’ + ‘F’ 
[*] Tooltips for most upgrades show their meaning even before they were researched
[*] Improved transitions between the Wiki, research, and events
[*] It is now possible to place Cat Stores on top of each other
[*] It is now possible to place Neural Networks on top of each other
[*] It is now possible to place (certain) Splitters on top of each other
[*] It is now possible to place Linear and Polynomial Regressions on top of each other
[*] It is now possible to place Manipulators and Long Manipulators on top of each other
[*] It is now possible to place certain buildings from related categories on top of each other
[*] It is now possible to unload Docks with Manipulators ([i]suggested by Trichouette[/i])
[*] It is now possible to manually place items on Transporters
[*] By pressing ’Shift’ one can now plan a whole line of Transporters/Cable from one point to another
[*] By pressing ’Shift’ + ‘Ctrl’ one can now plan a whole line of Transporters/Cable from one point to another, minding underground routes
[*] It is now possible to instantly teleport to the Monument
[*] Added research queue visualization
[/list]

[h2]Other Awesome Stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] Discord integration
[*] Rich presence on Steam enabled
[*] Bug fixes ([i]reported by Angl, perhonen, Mambo, Cat (the Black), Sylman[/i])
[*] Added community translation to the Estonian language ([i]by Sylman[/i])
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/5f03a845a3f990326576ef5fb5e95603b11a1a48.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone!

The biggest news about this edition of Dev Diaries: there're no dev diaries this month. Well, kind of. You see, the summer vacation period is upon us, and while KOTOVOD Learning Factory never stops, its devs sometimes need to.

That doesn't mean we'd leave you without content though! In fact, we've been keeping updating the visuals of cat items you'll be producing. Here's a summary of the job Sergei the artist did:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/b793d556086c270d2a08b6ff38cd1b555a1a8e26.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a52f70cfb5bfdba949533427af2e2a6f0c79c29e.jpg[/img]

The new building of the month is our brand new Cargo Dock: an intermediate form of evolution between a Small Cargo Dock and the mighty Two-Item Cargo Dock - this one holds but one item but in a greater amount than a Small Dock does. At the same time, Two-Item Cargo Dock now holds slightly less amounts of the two items, and researching it is no longer mandatory:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/69e95556b0e3f6062ccd02c426773b26abeb714f.jpg[/img]

And finally, here’s a couple of 2022 vs. 2023 screenshots - just so we could anticipate how the game has changed since last year’s summer:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/23d2d11da1defc74eea70f6ba1e1d48a75f84c5c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/79cd0015b6990b250bbca681c86142c994ae8efe.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/779676745d43730a770317b67b920862bfd9003d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a7da8b216acde21c2c80ed4d6f01f7b5317da9c3.jpg[/img]

A little heads-up: the next update is scheduled for August 15, so make sure you have a good summer rest, because there will be even more awesome cat-related awesome stuff once we return! In the meantime, here's some more Learning Factory content:

[list]
[*] You can watch one of the latest YouTube videos by [url=https://youtu.be/R7S2SoCY1Y0]Z1 Gaming[/url] (English) and [url=https://youtu.be/2eYCqfvzZSM]Canal do Void[/url] (Portuguese). By the way, do you have a favorite content maker who you'd like to see playing Learning Factory? Let us know in the comments, we'll try & reach them!
[*] If you haven't seen it already check out this [url=https://youtu.be/8vkPwarCh8M]recording of us playing Learning Factory[/url] back in May
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url] to discuss Learning Factory with fellow players and with us personally. We share WIP stuff straight from the devs’ table over there, too
[/list]

Have a great summer (or winter, if you happen to be in the Southern hemisphere)! See you in August.

notes.title: Learning Factory Dev Diaries, June 2023 - Stage 3 Complete, Content Intensifies
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/9756e02fd4fcd6fa81bc4e7906f4e493b1f8c89b.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone! You know the drill: the full release is approaching, much stuff is being added to the game these months, and lots of polishing tasks lie ahead of us!

That said, this issue of Dev Diaries will have little text and lots of pretty pictures: last month was marked with not one, but two major updates, a new story chapter, a handful of new buildings, and a bunch of redesigned items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/731168030fec2b868ee4e017c2b54d5d3494704b.png[/img]

Let's start with those buildings though: all of them will provide a lot of challenges and opportunities in the late parts of the game!

Gummy Press & Omniloom produce multiple types of High Quality items but require respectively exquisite ingredients. While Teleports allow you to travel between any parts of the map - given that you have enough Machine Learning capacity to afford them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/d8a227a1f024f69d301277aab00bd148c8dda6ac.png[/img]

Lots of fun stuff is happening under the surface of Mars, too: there're now glowy plants for you to harvest & make into the finest cat goods in the Solar System:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/d46f0d4f41059883ec52d3e6d534bd8ae9ee1e87.png[/img]

Speaking of goods, the great redesign of in-game art continues! By now, most of the items you produce in the game, including Quality and High Quality items, have their own distinctive look! Within the next couple of updates, we'll complete our collection of uniqe-looking items (that is if we don't introduce more items - no immediate plans for that but who knows!):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/1a1eee9369040fa64d274de6e80e3375630900be.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/71542d47a0eb816e1a4291112813f138d377e1ea.png[/img]

Sorry, we won't be showing much of the new comics (except for the art we used for cover image above) - we wouldn't dare to spoil the fun of discovering them by yourselves! But we assure you, they're in the game: adding them allowed us to mark Stage 3 of Early Access as complete! It's been a bit more than a year since we've closed Stage 2 - we considered it a legitimate excuse to show you some images, all taken sometime in May of 2021, 2022, and 2023, respectively:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/c259d10058bdfbe271b4a7e5fab0992c8e120729.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/ecdcb0e8a73017a092e2bc8e93a9fdb56608789c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/c7472ffab6b4fe34145de0fec0a5f76e473eb541.jpg[/img]

…here, have some more, wouldn't you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/5b25abab6e4a2f7de42f1a85c860aeff2bbaafe4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/56f3eade7f16615e33af8ceff6012e51ca3c6976.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/abf82c152f7295fc423f03f4ff8ca2f27fba553f.jpg[/img]

And here's our roadmap, so you could appreciate the path we've come along with you, our awesome players:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/e706e5c8d25cf526de8aab14f1aad6b767fd8df5.png[/img]

See you with more Learning Factory news in July! In the meantime, you're always welcom to chat with us on our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url]. Until we meet again!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/0a1fb10ffef6ee40ef93a1904ffab43e76dd7949.png[/img]

Here's anothe Major update, which changes the game quite a bit! As usual, it started with a small idea, but ended up in revision of many crafting recipes, along with adding a couple of new buildings, and updating a bunch of art on the way.

Enjoy it and please share your impressions in the comments and on our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]official Discord server[/url]:

[h3]Major v0.21.134 Released[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/bd5e0c8121120f578ec54cfc36ecbde255b4ea4e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] New building: a network of Teleports that can take you around the map in mere seconds, but each Teleport occupies 1 unit of your ML Capacity
[*] New building: Gummy Press allows you to make Quality (+) Gum and/or High Quality (++) Catnip Algae
[*] New(ish) item: Neon Cotton Plant grows Underground; research a Growing Neon Cotton Plant on the Research Tree to unlock a possibility to build Cotton Collectors, Hedges and use Fertilizers Underground
[*] New(ish) item: Deep Algae works pretty much the same way, allowing to place Algae Harvesters and Booms Underground, once Growing Deep Algae is researched
[*] Dormitory upgrades cost less money but will require certain items: the higher the level - the more complex items will be required
[*] Catificial Intelligence Endless Research Project now increases ML Capacity with every level reached
[*] Fungi From Pluto Endless Research Project now also provides a chance to automatically fertilized a newly emerged plant
[*] Soil auto-crafting limit increased from 300 to 1000 ([i]via Trichouette[/i])
[*] Fertilizer auto-crafting limit increased from 100 to 500 units 
[*] Added another Blueprint suggestion to the Wiki
[*] New music
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/d46f0d4f41059883ec52d3e6d534bd8ae9ee1e87.png[/img]

[list]
[*] New upgrade: Gummy Press can be upgraded to make High Quality (++) Gum (2 different recipes available)
[*] New upgrade for Metal Furnace that increases smelting speed
[*] The upgrade for increased production quality of Fish Makers now provides High Quality Fish instead of Quality Fish. The recipe's item requirements & unlock requirements have been altered as well
[*] New upgrade: Cat House Maker can be upgraded for increased production speed
[*] New recipe: all Underground Drills now include a recipe for crafting twice as fast compared to default recipe
[*] New recipe: Metal Furnace now includes 2 alternate recipes that make smelting twice as fast compared to default recipe
[*] New recipe: Concrete Mixer now includes a default recipe for producing Quality Concrete twise as fast compared to original recipe
[*] New recipe: added an alternative recipe for making Chewing Gum
[*] New recipe: Claw Sharpener Maker now includes a default recipe for producing Quality Claw Sharpeners
[*] New recipe: Bling Machine now includes 2 alternate recipes for producing Blings and Quality Blings
[*] New recipe: Cat House Maker now includes 2 alternate recipes for producing Quality and High Quality Cat Houses (both recipes require Concrete)
[*] Default Smoothie recipe no longer requires Apple Boxes
[*] Producing Cat Food now requires 2 Fish instead of 1
[*] Default Graphic Card recipe now requires 2 Microchips instead of 3
[*] Bubble Gum Mixer now produces Gum in batches of 3
[*] Time for selected recipes was altered within 1-2 ticks to better balance proportions between interdependent buildings

notes.title: Dev Diaries, May 2023: Cat Clones, Teleports & Fancy-Looking Goods
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/4655f4d1c2cb929bd9951c41635c380a48d8c24b.jpg[/img]

During these late stages of development, writing an introduction to every other edition of these Dev Diaries becomes a more challenging task every time. E.g., there isn't much to report: the majority of game mechanics are already in place, and now our work mostly revolves around tons of polishing, visual updates, and concluding the game's story (sounds like a piece of cake, right?).

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150090

On the brighter side, we've got lots of new images to share!

[h2]Views of the Future
[/h2]
Learning Factory has changed so much, that when our friends who played the 2021 edition of the game see the latest screenshots, they're asking whether it's a sequel to Learning Factory. What do you think though?

[h3]2021[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/aa0820357f54b12d5971e661fbe048b61592e4a3.jpg[/img]
[h3]2023[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/89eba9578499c3055bc19810da9f8e7703d78f6b.jpg[/img]

The work on the visuals continues as more and more items of different quality levels get their own unique design. The old ones are subject to revision, too! Just a couple of weeks back we introduced new metals, along with gems, seaweed, and cotton:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/94a2036809c0ac080a1e261c6f6a17f58c19f7d6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/f515aa9f2061a7d5c8e7f6879750c572070097c6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/caeac720cc3a1e0a4afd518201befa09f5057378.jpg[/img]

[h2]Clone Paws & Other Wonders[/h2]

Although all basic mechanics are still in place, some occasional new buildings keep emerging in the game. Sometimes they're based on community ideas, like this cozy cloning chamber:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/07baaae76fde767b79eac9d1e534345173e80de3.jpg[/img]

This spectacular device makes an exact copy of any visiting Cat, which is considered to be an android with a digital copy of a cat donor's mind. Known side effects: clones are traveling on Transporters, facing backward.

Both cats are alive at the same time.

Another new building and an instrument at your disposal is called Chillout Space:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/98cce9f35415ce6a4f6075fead3c4f2e4b83f1ce.jpg[/img]

It ensures zero productivity and 100% laziness efficiency. These conditions do motivate cats to recommend your Factory to their friends, but they wouldn’t bother doing even that: an AI-powered algorithm is there to compose a tempting text that will bring more like-minded cats to your campus, while their buddies are taking (yet another) break from doing nothing before they decide to return to relaxed shopping.

Surprisingly as it is, that’s not just it! A couple of other new buildings are also scheduled for the upcoming update next week. One of them makes an advanced edition of Gum:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/6fcbc35768c6c95575f032632d6fb81c7d73d5f6.jpg[/img]

(A fun fact: by this day, some of our players don't suspect that our game actually has 3D graphics, with detailed models and such!)

While the other is codenamed ‘Teleport’. Any ideas about what it does though?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a93be5a3b90101b9f48dd7d2aa88c1b7ce1f85cb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/3ede8c7332f11bfc1957870c3d28caf5eda3da18.jpg[/img]

What else are we working on? Thousands of little and big things are happening under the hood: optimization, polishing, bug fixing, new sounds, more new visuals, more optimization and polishing, and then some. 

New gameplay features emerge from this seemingly chaotic, yet meticulously planned and controlled creative abyss. For one, there are new and more profitable deals in the Trade Ports. And Tunnels and Splitters can now be placed on Rafts as well - a small change in the rules, a potentially huge expansion of logistic maneuvers, especially for those playing on island-filled maps!

Another little change that may make a big splash is that bunch of new recipes for items that we've added to certain buildings. Some of them will allow you to craft higher quality goods, others give a productivity boost. This feature will be but one of many exciting ideas that we can't way to see you try, come next update.

And if you'll think some of them don't feel right for any reason - we'll be more than happy to hear from you! Part of the idea behind us releasing a new update every fortnight is that we're building the game based on your feedback! So let us know your thoughts on the [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url] or right here in the comments!

[h2]* * *[/h2]

Mark these words: we're going to paint some plates green on our [url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1150090/extras/roadmap.png?t=1682443480]Early Access roadmap[/url] very soon! Wanna make a bet on which ones it will be? You'll know the results before the next edition of these Dev Diaries comes out! Until we meet again!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/2aa28008b66484658b6296abe67ec1e7bb61df19.png[/img]

[h3][i]First things first: Learning Factory is on sale until May 1! Get your copy of the game, 34% off![/i][/h3]

As promised in the latest edition of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150090/view/3720578716713303172]developer diaries[/url], this update brings a lot of changes in the visuals for many items on your Factories. Because most of the items now vary in quality and marking them with mere silver or gold stars would be plain boring, wouldn't it? 

So now you can clearly distinguish those top-notch cat goods from boring regular ones. We hope that it will add some motivation for you to optimize your production and ensure your catstomers get only the best-looking items!

Naturally, that's not the only change. Check out the other awesome stuff in this awesome new version of the game:

[*] More phrases for legendary cats
[*] Added many new sounds for items

[*] Terraforming now allows replacing tiles of appropriate type under plants without removing them
[*] CPU Trade Guild now allows exchanging goods for Cat Knowledge Archives in Tier 5
[*] All Splitters and Tunnels can now be placed on Rafts
[*] Increased profitability of deals in Trade Ports when exchanging goods for Cat Knowledge
[*] New upgrade: increased cargo hold for Zeppelins
[*] Slightly improved hills generation
[/list]
[h3]QoL & Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pressing Ctrl+Click on a research adds the project to research queue
[*] Pressing Ctrl+Click on a building on the pannel in the bottom of the screen results in crafting another building of the same type
[*] Symbols limit for naming Docks and Zeppelin Routes increased
[*] Added a search field for the Research Tree
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[*] Bug fixes, especially for airships

notes.title: Dev Diaries, April 2023: Cat Blimps, Underground Fishing & Endless Research
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/560fd7e3692b528264d35ef7ca8960ba9fcaaa0a.png[/img]

If you didn't know that already, Learning Factory is being developed by a team of just four people. Back in 2020, when we started drafting the game, none of us would expect it to become as big! All we wanted was to make a tycoon game about a cat store… And here we are, with a giant map of 3 biomes and an underground level, Trade Ports, Cat Guilds, the I.L.L.U.M.I.N.A.T.I., and now - cat blimps! Among other things.

And we're far from done. Let's try and sort out all the good stuff that appeared in the game in the past month.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

[h3]When Cats Fly[/h3]

Cat Zeppelins have been in the game for some time now, helping you transfer your goods to the harder-to-reach parts of your Factory campus. One thing they could not carry was… well, cats. However, our very curious players have tried to fit their furry catstomers into Zeppelins. Some of them even succeeded, naturally resulting in the game crashing. That's when we decided that passenger airships are a good idea. Enter Cat Blimps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/4607184584f16aababb16694540c362a9c178e6d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/54fe44cfa2c1aaea83a3f507fe3aadb5f3ea1b68.jpg[/img]

One of our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url] community members, Jiiniasu, has contributed as well with a sketch of their own:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/2e938f3c7dc63b37409ee40e9458f677ccd03b32.jpg[/img]

It took some time and effort from Sergei the artist to come up with something mad enough while prototyping the design of these mighty airships. The earliest versions looked somewhat like a flying beaver:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/dda67e078987e4aba9179a649eb9a8f9b6a92410.png[/img]

It became more cat-like after a couple of iterations:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/845beb4dd6c1587b58059a0e511a92ef9cf16375.png[/img]

…then we've just added some cats, and:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/9165c9fa8811abda233f8450900382cd2c86186e.gif[/img]

The Blimps are designed with all your cat's desires in mind: the insight of the gondola is shaped as a cardboard box, with scratch-resistant walls and catnip-flavored shakes served on board! We'd remind the pawssengers to fasten their seat belts, but, knowing the nature of cats, we don't expect them to comply.

Blimp stations (or, as we call them, Pawssenger Docks) also took some time to contemplate:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/ea60de1a68632fcdaa68744416493198bb099b79.jpg[/img]

Sergei found inspiration in a special book dedicated to the bus stop design of the Soviet Union - apparently, they were very diverse, often astonishingly beautiful! Anyway, here's the final version, with cats and whatnot:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/0f5b7f577110dca5220fd2004e5feabf3c91aaf8.jpg[/img]

Take your cats for a ride in the sky! 

[h3]Endless Research for Filthy-Rich Engineers[/h3]

This next feature might not look as spectacular, but boy, is it useful! Since Learning Factory is a stress-free game, the players who made it to the late stages of the game often find themselves with ridiculous amounts of in-game currency on their deposits. 

However, even with all the technologies unlocked, the potential for optimization of one's Factory is endless. That said, you are now allowed to invest your profits and acquire very useful perks for your Factory and your character, so you could optimize more, earn even more money, get better perks, and optimize again, times infinity:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/eec67d776e3ef0afe936ccf1bcd0048fab2aeeed.png[/img]

The aforementioned perks include a speed increase for the character and/or Zeppelins, a research speed boost, an overall profits increase, boosted growth of plants, a chance to create two buildings instead of one while crafting… and much more! They're as powerful as they are expensive, so if you happen to be a minmaxer kind of a player, those research projects will keep you busy for dozens of hours. No need to thank us!

[h3]Another Round Underground[/h3]

When we introduced the underground level of Mars in Learning Factory, it was a rather boring, lifeless place that was only good for facilitating de-spaghettifying the logistics. Here's a brief list of features that we have added since: underground oceans, lava & lava Rafts, underground Zeppelins, underground Metal sources, Lava Furnaces, and now - fishing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/727791d37ebfcfef60b0ef2c9dbf395850c66494.png[/img]

Yes, really. But it's not just that: upon upgrading your Multitool you will not only be able to catch fish in the dark subsurface waters, but you'll also be able to fish for metals in lava! And if you need more space or more confidence - you can now pour concrete on lava, thus making it traversable!

With all that, it makes the Underground of Mars a pretty fun place to hang out! But we still have a couple of things to be added up our sleeves. Just you wait! In the meantime…

[h3]The Big Redesign [/h3]

If you are following these diaries regularly, you might already know that one of the most important tasks on our table is to make Learning Factory prettier than ever for when it goes to full release this year. We've done that before, too: the game has changed more than once, including the big rehaul of the visual style last August.

The work on this aspect of the game continues! In the next update, we're planning to change the looks of certain items. As it already happened with Yarn Balls and many more items, Copper will look different depending on the quality of items you produce. Here's a work-in-progress teaser:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/36ed0cf359e14c3864530815378dd3d8955c2ecc.jpg[/img]

A new Gold design is on the way, too:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/353db510ff988b8638802c40b42c1c0fb218e2e7.png[/img]

New Iron, Cotton, and Gems are also to be expected! This upcoming update (scheduled for release on April 25) is going to be pretty! Oh, and we've also re-rendered the good ol’ Cotton Collector, it's already in the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/9997a843311f6343026da6880bb1ff6e94646f2d.png[/img]

Bear with us! With each passing month, Learning Factory is becoming a more beautiful, deep, and wholesome game. See you in the next edition of our Dev Diaries!

notes.title: New Update: Cat Blimps & Infite Quests For Knowledge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/281f89c5c63f43486a75551650722bd49c11e3d8.png[/img]

It's been more than 2 years since Learning Factory was released in Early Access, and we're eternally grateful to the players, who joined us way back in 2021 and 2022! This week's update comes with a couple of features, that will definitely help experienced engineers rethink their logistics and boost their factories - all for the sake of making cats happy, of course.

[h3]Major v0.20.126 Released[/h3]
[list]
[*] Endless researches: 15 special end-game scientific projects that allow you to spend ridiculous amounts of money for serious gameplay bonuses (see below)
[*] New building: Pawssenger Dock - for your cats to wait for boarding and being carried around the Factory
[*] Naturally, it comes with a new airship: Cat Blimps!
[*] New upgrade: High Quality (++) Cat Houses
[*] Cat House Maker has Quality (+) recipe by default
[*] After cats leave tasting buildings, items they've added to their shopping list are displayed above them
[*] When you get a reward for a Dr. Katz's request, it's visually displayed above the character's head
[*] Pipette tool now works on grown up plants (a growing plant will stick to the cursor)
[*] Cats slightly rebalanced
[*] Research cost slightly rebalanced
[*] Order of research projects in Terraforming category slightly changed
[*] Improved tutorial
[*] Campaign loading speed decreased (up to 10 seconds)
[*] Freeplay premade maps loading speed decreased
[*] Saving game time optimization
[*] Save game file size decreased
[*] Minor SFX improvements
[*] Performance optimization
[*] UI/UX fixes
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/70ce691800dccdc32d61d40c723b181376a38c34.png[/img]

By the way, the idea of cat-shaped Cat Blimp was originally suggested in discussion with the community, so if you think we've got crazy ideas, you haven't seen the people playing our games :) Anyway, here's what the legend began with (a sketch by [i]Jiiniasu[/i]):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/2e938f3c7dc63b37409ee40e9458f677ccd03b32.jpg[/img]

[h3]Infinite Research: Eternal Quest For Knowledge[/h3]

Enter our long-awaited feature for the players who are bearing the burden of being filthy rich and out of projects to research! These one will keep your cat scientists occupied for ages AND provide handsome bonuses to your Factory and your catstomers:

Here’s the current structure of research projects and their characteristics, divided by knowledge fields:

Upgrades: [b]Fortune Activator[/b] (income increase)  - [b]Cat Smell Amplifier[/b] (Hype increase) - [b]Square Cardboard Space Signal Emitter[/b] (Loyalty increase)

Production: [b]Time Machine[/b] (increased craft & trading speed) - [b]Dark Matter Condenser[/b] (chance of creating extra building) - [b]Nanoproduction[/b] (chance of creating extra item while crafting)

Science: [b]CatGPT[/b] (perfect ML prediction chance && data quality increase) - [b]Cat Hive Mind[/b] (extra researcher XP) - [b]Catificial Intelligence[/b] (extra articles quality)

Logistics: [b]Space Bender[/b] (increased character speed) - [b]FTL Engine[/b] (increased Zeppelin speed) - [b]Black Hole Pocket[/b] (extra Storage && Stores capacity)

Terraforming: [b]Growth Hormones[/b] (chance of extra plant multiplication) - [b]Fungi From Pluto[/b] (plant growth speed increase) - [b]Plantastic Cloning[/b] (chance of keeping a plant intact for harvesting it twice in a row)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/eec67d776e3ef0afe936ccf1bcd0048fab2aeeed.png[/img]

Now, we've got a question for you: [b]what other parameters would you like to be able to modify with such research[/b]?  

Some of the projects above were developed with help from our community, but we could use more ideas - because in the end, we're always trying to make features the will be useful to you, the players!

Send your thoughts to [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url] of ours or leave a comment!

notes.title: Dev Diaries, March 2023: Subsidizine Researchers & Demandin Dr. Katz
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/46dd1be3146cdc1b04310f687cbcaabe69e88df7.png[/img]

Hey everyone! It is well known that the older you get, the faster flies the time. Apparently, a similar principle applies to video games: the closer to release, the shorter the next month seems. Is it the middle of March already? It is. And apparently, we've made a lot of progress.

[h3]Blueprints Complete![/h3]

If you were not using this mighty powerful instrument before, you should give it a try now! You can now make changes in the Blueprints straight from the Blueprint Library, but what’s even more exciting - you can instantly craft buildings over the Blueprints by pressing ‘Ctrl + click’ (by default) on them. Or even better - you can automatically build stuff around you by pressing just one button ('J’by default)! Just make sure you have enough resources for it.

[previewyoutube=K9Bs9YEixhM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Visual Update: It Has Begun!
[/h3]
Mark these words: come summer, you will see a whole different Learning Factory! Needless to say, the graphics in the game is far from final: we only have one Sergei, the artist. But his talent is truly unstoppable: he already started polishing key buildings in the game, adding shadows and other very important details. The first subject to transform is, of course, the Yarn Ball Maker - one of the first and most important structures at any stage of your Factory development:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/bf5e206879adcc9157765cd2bafee35b25f63d7c.png[/img]

Needless to say, redesigning the Yarn Ball Maker means redesigning Yarn Balls as well:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/951153bd96c10dc01a98e08cd850cb58cd682fdf.png[/img]

It took us some time to implement because Sergei has a habit of sometimes going WAY too deep into details. This time he spent hours studying the techniques of weaving in the textile industry, so he could make Yarn Balls look truly realistic (for a game about cats on Mars in the future, yes, why?).

Eventually, the resulting Yarn Balls ended up becoming so realistic, they’d look visually noisy when the camera zoomed out too far… Therefore, we had to postpone implementing them until the next update. But they arrived at last:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/42d3d684b0a99a179b383ced37abd4c87cfe5c76.png[/img]

Oh, but what about that delicious Yarn Ball with a gold star, on the right? Oh, it’s just a new type of item, combining the softness and playful potential of Yarn Balls with the irresistible vibes of Catnip Algae. We even had to design a special machine for you to be able to craft it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/2cdd3f2148a09d0269c20a8871c12930f7e77338.png[/img]

[h3]Gameplay Changes: Sales, Subsidizing & Dr. Katz Requests[/h3]
We have a confession to make: lots of features we implement on a bi-monthly basis are not listed in these humble Dev Diaries. Mostly because we don’t want to overburden you with too many details - we do make a lot of changes to the game. But the most recent update introduced a bunch of cool new things that are worth mentioning:

There’s now an option to subsidize cat researchers working in Experimental Labs. For a reasonable price, you can make it so the next 100 articles written by a researcher will bring them twice as much experience. They don’t go out of their laboratories much, but they still like money, who knows why! Cats are mysterious.

You can also spend money on upgrading Dr. Katz’s requests (those mini-quests that you see in the upper left corner of the screen from time to time) - the challenge will become harder but the reward will be better, too!

And to earn money to afford these tools, you can turn on Sales pricing mode in a Smart Store! It’s an addition to already existing manual pricing and machine learning pricing. With this thing on, all items in a Store will be sold at minimum prices, but the satisfied cats will become more loyal, which will bring you more profit in the future.

[h3]Now What?[/h3]
Once you get locked into serious feature adding, the tendency is to push it as far as you can. Even with the game’s full release approaching, we still got a couple of awesome things up our sleeves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a4b7eb544b620e11f668c952281d7c6e36ed39b5.jpg[/img]

One of them is Cat Zeppelins. Like, for transporting cats this time. Once we introduced Cargo Zeppelins to the game, some players started trying to put cats inside of them, though they were never designed for this. Some of the players even succeeded in doing that (which, naturally, resulted in the game crashing). So we thought it was a fine idea. We haven’t heard of any historical cases of cats traveling in giant blimps, so we see it as our chance to finally make things right, even if just in a video game. Cats deserve to be able to fly in airships, dammit!

The other big feature we’re working on is dedicated to those who made the best of the features from the paragraphs above and is now carrying the burden of being filthy rich. The codename of this feature is ‘endless researches’, and it will allow you to invest ridiculous amounts of money to squeeze the game for various benefits for your Factory: increased Hype, increased XP levels for scientists, a chance to craft an additional building while crafting, a speed boost for Zeppelins - you name it! As long as you keep the sweet dough coming.

See you in a month! Things are about to get exciting as ever as the full release approaches. Glory to science! Glory to KOTOVOD!

notes.title: New Update v0.19.125: Sales, Subsidizing & New Yarn Balls
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/70677fe6a87bcf8fd060eef8a04cf15269150f3e.png[/img]

It's not the length of list of changes that defines an update. This one is marked as 'Regular' but the list of changes is actually pretty long. There are lots of things that we added and improved here in there - they might not sound as cool as finalizing Blueprint mode. Nor they are as epic as something that we're planning for the next update (wink-wink, nudge-nudge).

Still, they change the experience from the game a great deal. Here's how.

[h2]v0.19.125 Released[/h2]
[h3]New buildings & Sales[/h3]
[list]
[*] New buildings: Quality Manipulator and Long Quality Manipulators. For manipulating items, you know. With quality
[*] Added an option to craft Quality Batteries, default recipe is added to Battery Maker
[*] Sales mode for Smart Cat Store (to be unlocked on the progress bar of the Research Tree): allows selling items at minimum prices that leads to increased loyalty of cats who shop there
[*] 4 upgrades that increase the amount of items that can be added to a cat's shopping list upon visiting tasting buildings
[*] Added statistics for added Loyalty (from tasting buildings and Roadside Boutiques shopping)
[*] Added statistics for recommended items in tasting buildings
[/list]
[h3]Researching[/h3]
[list]
[*] Subsidizing option in Research Hub: invest money to boost EXP gain for the next 100 articles for a researcher in the Hub
[*] Experience gain ratio slightly increased
[*] Research difficulty rebalanced and now depends only on how far from the start a research project is
[*] Research Tree screen now displays the overall amount of Cat Knowledge Archives ([i]via Oniguro[/i])
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/42d3d684b0a99a179b383ced37abd4c87cfe5c76.png[/img]
[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list]
[*] New visuals for Yarn Balls
[*] New visuals for Yarn Ball Maker
[*] Lava terrain visuals slightly improved
[/list]
[h3]Dr. Katz requests[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an option to decline or upgrade Dr. Katz's requests (to be unlocked on the progress bar of the Research Tree): invest money to add challenge and receive a better reward
[*] Dr. Katz's requests are now sometimes rewarded with Manipulators, Soil and Fertile Soil

[/list]

[h2]Got Blueprints?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a0014ba700fca4d9ceb398397aa6da068f8b61a5.png[/img]
Here’s an awesome trade offer.

[b]We get:[/b] Blueprints from your Factories that you consider so cool/useful, that all Learning Factory players must have it

[b]You get:[/b] your work added to the global Blueprint Library and your name in the game (in case we and the commuity find your Blueprint useful). Pictured above is one of the first works by one of our players - check it out in the game now!

[i]How to make a Blueprint:[/i]
[list]
[*] Press and hold Ctrl and drag your mouse over a group of buildings/object
[*] Press Ctrl+S to save the group as a Blueprint in the Library ('B' by default)
[*] Don’t forget to enter a name and a description of what your blueprint does (this is also where your name will appear, if we select your Blueprint for the official list)
[*] You can also make simple editions to a custom Blueprint in the Library: delete items with the right mouse button, rotate the whole Blueprint or invert the surface and underground levels
[/list]
[i]How to share a Blueprint:[/i]
[list]
[*] Go to Blueprint Library ('B' by default)
[*] Find your work there
[*] Press the arrow icon (‘Export Blueprint’) next to a Blueprint’s name. Or press ‘Details’ and find the ‘Export’ button there
[*] The Blueprint will be copied to your clipboard as text, you can then paste it anywhere and send it to anyone you want (it will be attached as a text file if you paste it to Discord)
[/list]
[i]How to import a Blueprint:[/i]
[list]
[*] In the Blueprint Library, find the ‘Import’ field in the lower part of the screen
[*] Paste the text code of a Blueprint you got somewhere
[*] Hit the green arrow button 
[/list]
