notes.title: New Update: Biomes, Juicy Cacti and Raw Concrete (+Q&A About Future Plans)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/2f9e270af40a1b19f6416917e73d308442beb8b0.png[/img]

You know you can't stop the progress, especially when this progress is pushed forward by KOTOVOD's own Dr. Katz!

Although Mars was generally terraformed years ago, the process is in no way over yet! Thanks to the I.L.L.U.M.I.N.A.T.I. tech, it was made possible to make climate on Mars more diverse! Because diverse climate zones inspire curiosity, and cats are very curious, you know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/24bece1019646afe926138c00d47d6b0b465efe8.png[/img]

There's now Jungle and Tundra and Desert areas on Mars! Various plants prefer different climate, which means: more job for you, hardworking engineers! Glory to science! Glory to Catopia!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

[h3]Version 0.10.64 Released![/h3]
[list]
[*] Introducing [b]cold and hot climate regions[/b] (available upon starting new game), which will host different biomes
[*] [b]Tundra[/b] now appears in the cold region, while [b]Deserts[/b] and [b]Jungle[/b] emerge in the hot region (available upon starting new game)
[*] Apple Trees now mostly grow in the Jungle, which is also the best biome for growing them, from now on
[*] Catnip Algae now mostly grows in the Torpical Water
[*] Fir Trees are now generated in the Tundra biome. Also, Growing Fir Trees don't grow in hot regions
[*] When placing a crafted tile of Soil, Rich Soil, Shallow or Deep Water in a climate region, it will acquire the properties of a respective biome
[*] Concrete Mixer can now extract Sand from the Desert biome
[*] New object: [b]Icebergs[/b] emerge in cold regions and produce Fish, when harvested by hand
[*] New object: [b]Juicy Cacti[/b] can be found in hot regions and produce Catnip Juice, when harvested by hand
[*] New object: [b]Growing Juicy Cacti[/b] can be found, picked up and planted elsewhere. They can also be researched on the Research Tree, to be produced and planted
[*] New object: [b]Raw Concrete[/b] can be found in the Desert biome, it can be harvested and used for building
[*] New dev-made Ruins added, including biome-specific
[*] A fan-made Ruin added (the credit goes to [b]Kryptonik[/b])
[*] Sliders in Freeplay mode work slightly differently: resources are no longer interconnected
[*] Fixed bug of Turing Trees that could break their generation cycle
[*] Bug fixes
[*] UI fixes
[*] Optimization
[*] Game loading optimization
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/888aae86537992e35ccbaf3ec441d00338c87173.png[/img]

[h3](Q&A) Cat to the Future[/h3]
Last week, we've had a really productive discussion with our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url] community. It all started with us working on one of our next big features: unlockable territories on the map. Here's a concept of a hypothetical map look (a work in progress, naturally):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/e1fc2bc6f09399615afa1f1d1d9564b32e1ac549.jpg[/img]
The idea was to let the players explore the map in a new way. The problem was, we really needed ideas on how to make this mechanics really intriguing, without disrupting the game vibes. We've asked our community to share their ideas and concerns. And now we want to share them with you, too!

[b]Q:[/b] Why make you spend money to unlock it, and will you be able or unable to progress without it? Will you present a knapsack problem if you spend money but then can't achieve a necessary task due to lack of coins? [i]-rik[/i]
[b]A:[/b] The way we see it right now, the territories will be unlocked with both money and different resources. You won't be able to progress without unlocking them at some point (late in the game): different areas will be set in different biomes, which have different unique resources. 

[b]Q:[/b] [Aren't you afraid that this mechanic] force limits players play areas? Typically in factory style games you could run 10000 tiles away from the initial area at the very beginning and the game wont do much to stop you from doing so.
[b]A:[/b] We are afraid that some players might feel like being held back by that, we honestly are! Thank Dr. Katz, we're still in Early Access, so we could make alterations, based on player feedback! Our first solution to that problem: we'll make the campaign map 1.56 times bigger, and the initially available area will be huge enough for you to roam freely!

[b]Q:[/b] But would buying the land ASAP mean that you can't then buy something that you need to progress an earlier puzzle that you haven't yet completed? [i]-rik[/i]
[b]A:[/b] Nothing like that, is on our minds :) There are no soft locks due to the lack of money in the game

[b]Q:[/b] What concern I have about biome specific resources are that you would need to build an extremely long conveyor belt to bring them to the shop. I don't know how normal is this in typical factory game, but as someone who wants to minimize footprint, it is not a pleasant feeling. [i]-Rich Richie[/i]
[b]A:[/b] There's already a hoverboard, a jetpack and a couple of upgrades to help you traverse the map, that is not that huge at the moment. Did you know that you can lay down transporters WHILE riding a hoverboard? Also, there are no enemies to disturb you or your conveyor belts.
As for addressing this issue in the future... We have actually been discussing zeppelins as an alternative means of transport, but it was on our list of "crazy ideas that we might return to some time later" ;)

[b]Q:[/b] If we are the only ones on that planet what in lore wise is stopping us from just naturally expanding? Who would the coins be going to and why are they trying to sell the land on this barron planet anyways?[i]-Kryptonik[/i]
[b]A:[/b] Our current concept is that there are cats who act as landlords of certain territories. They could make you trade offers! Additionally, Mars is in no way barren (especially with that last update), it was terraformed by joined forces of cats and humans!

[b]Q:[/b] We had a MAP in this game???? [i]-dyigitpolat[/i]
[b]A:[/b] YES :) Here's another work-in-progress view of a mini map, divided into unlockable territories:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/065245909836579fcf5a130bf9b88a3ee420c5fb.jpg[/img]

Additionally, here are a couple of questions not related to territories, but which seemed interesting to us anyway (all asked by our friend [i]Kryptonik[/i]):

[b]Q:[/b] Will there be any modding tools to help create workshop content and is there any news on when workshop content will come out?
[b]A:[/b] We are planning modding tools, but don't have any due dates at this point. First thing we're planning to add is sharing scenarios, Ruins and map keys.
We've had the opportunity of letting the players share user generated content from the start, and the game is designed in a way, that adding new resources is done by creating a couple of strings in a spreadsheet. We'll see how the players like the features mentioned above, and think how to expand them, based on that!

[b]Q:[/b] Is it safe to expect more resources or buildings in game in the future? 
[b]A:[/b] Definitely, you can see respective points pinned to our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/1150090/extras/roadmap.png?t=1646903501]roadmap[/url][/b] (see '20+ New Researches' in Stage 4).

[b]Q:[/b] How close do the devs feel the game is to a "finished" state where no new additions to the game would be added outside of bug fixes/patches
[b]A:[/b] We'd say, we're about halfway there! And we'll also keep supporting the game post-release, content updates are also quite likely. But again, it all depends on feedback from you folks!

We rely heavily on our community and we'd like to discuss features with you on a regular basis! If you feel like joining our friendly ranks, come to our Discord server (now with separate channel for cat memes!):

[url=https://discord.gg/ludenio][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/be9283faefe041039063e25d934121fca2a834b7.png[/img][/url]

And don't forget to follow Learning Factory on Steam to get the news about new updates as soon as they're out there

notes.title: New Update: New Character Art, Ruins On The Map And Massive Optimization
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/6ca274639c1300bd5b918ea85642bec2c2be7d16.png[/img]

You jnow what they say: you can't build Catopia without breaking down some old factory ruins... Ok, that's not exactly what they say, but this is what's happening in the areas surrounding KOTOVOD campus right now.

It is widely known that KOTOVOD started out as an experimental project way back in the XX century. The experiment was a failure due to so many reasons (main of them being humans not able to understand the genius ideas of their cats). Nevertheless, a lot of work was done, a lot of structures had been erected and eventually left to rot...

Until you have arrived! Thanks to our hardworking engineers, our I.L.L.U.M.I.N.A.T.I. curators finaly had their paws free to start prospecting for the remains of older KOTOVOD. As always, they have succeeded! From now on, you'll be able to detect the Ruins of the factory's ancient campus, and put into good use whatever you find there!

That said: please get back to work now, engineers... Hey, did you get your hair cut? You look kinda different...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/c30bc909c5de0457d8cf57952a6e9a2887afdb13.gif[/img]

[*] [b]New character art[/b]; more frames in animation, too
[*] [b]Ruins[/b] of the old KOTOVOD campus are now being spawned on maps (but only after starting another new game)
[*] Small-sized Scenarios in the Editor can now be saved as Ruins and appear on regular maps in Freeplay Mode
[*] In relation to that, the minimal size of a Scenario has been decreased from 32 to 10 tiles
[*] [b]OPTIMIZATION[/b] (yes, in caps, yes, again). [b]Warning:[/b] when you load a saved game file from an earlier version, you will experience a situation when all the cats/objects on all your Transporter lines will disappear. Sorry about that, but worry not: just wait for a couple of minutes until those lines get filled with newly emerged cats/objects. No cats will be harmed. Many thanks to community member [b]Da Hooman[/b] for providing a saved game that helped us optimize the game some more!
[*] Mouse grid can now be activated even when you don't have an object on your mouse cursor
[*] Turing Trees now have animation upon emerging/disappearing
[*] Bugs and UI fixes

notes.title: New Update: Explosive & Legendary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/e6ce0061252e728f3eccad482533bdab1ae6ca44.png[/img]

Hard work eventually pays off! Even though all the profits eventually go for funding new research and reaching Catopia, it is important to find a moment to stop and smell the roses (before going back to hard and never-ending work).

Okay, roses don't grow on Mars just yet. But you can smell the success when you see legendary cats visiting the Factory! The word of KOTOVOD's glorious deeds in the field of feline economy is spreading, and celebrities from the furry society start emerging on the campus! Bear in mind, their requests are sometimes... unconventional.

When the fattest cats are coming to your Factory, it's sometimes important to be able to make quick alterations and adapt your production to meet the high society's highest standards. Which is where the next invention of the I.L.L.U.M.I.N.A.T.I. scientists comes in handy: enter the Smart Dynamite! It's powered by machine learning and allows wreaking havoc without the fear of harming cats or other sentient lifeforms, such as KOTOVOD's workers. We value you, because you're working so hard and we don't pay you anyway!

The economy is BOOMING this week at KOTOVOD Learning Factory! Glory to science!

[h3]IVersion 0.10.60 Released![/h3]
[list]
[*] New cats: Legendary cat characters will be visiting your Factory! There are five of them now, can you spot them all?
[*] New research: Dynamite! It's a smart kind of explosive that only destroys things approved by the I.L.L.U.M.I.N.A.T.I. Ergo, it can't harm cats or key research infrastructure... But it's great for quick landscape changing: capable of destroying a good chunk of ground, leaving a hole full of water
[*] There's also an upgrade for Dynamite, resulting in a smaller piece of Dynamite
[*] Lunar New Year decorations: asian-themed cats and Store visuals
[*] Hills now appear on the map: they can't be crossed, but they can be blown up (new game required for hills to emerge)
[*] Other terrain visual improvements
[*] Tutorial updated: new tasks added, older tasks clarified
[*] Improved Wiki: crafting and item description added
[*] Research queue display improved
[*] Crafting queue display improved
[*] Hills, rivers and lakes can be turned off entirely while in Freeplay mode
[*] Mouse grid now available for all buildings
[*] Bug fixes
[*] UI/UX fixes
[*] Optimization
[*] You can now pet the cat in the menu (click the cat to make it happen!)

notes.title: Developer Diaries, Dev 2021: Dreaming CATopia
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/2caadfe1e1b2d2afd2ec927956ea9a3803ce4a20.jpg[/img]
Hello and welcome to this month's edition of Learning Factory developer diaries! Today we'll talk about global progression and the great mission behind KOTOVOD. We will discuss the mysterious, interstellar origins of cats and, of course, Holiday preparations!

But first, treat yourself with some fresh cat photos from our team:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/85a4462323c2bc1ab38e56acd5d5f0fd3a63ebdc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/f3042f44939725670e02563ee1c2f90d9b7f8ac7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/5e220fa39acfbcfe8ff8c64bd82947b36a984470.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/f8af1aa1902ac5ab7947022317450b291afc1e60.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/f30fee1bdf86c1f680e74024fc93393c1840646f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Global Progression: Next Stop - Catopia![/h2]
Having released a couple of major updates and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150090/view/3021344686054390428]closed Stage 1 of Early Access[/url], we've decided to take some time and get into philosophic mood, trying to understand: what's our game is all about, to us and to our players?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

Ok, we know that Learning Factory is about building an industrial cluster. But most importantly, it's about making cats happy. We have been studying feedback from our players in an effort to find the essence of what our players value most in the game. 

Apparently, the top features are: [b]relaxing gameplay[/b] (no carnivorous insects!), endless [b]optimization[/b] and, by all means, [b]cats[/b]! Hence our new story-driven trailer:

[previewyoutube=nayzW9DjnHs;full][/previewyoutube]

How do you see the game though? You can help us a great deal by [url=https://forms.gle/9KjwEqtKbZoVTnbu7][b]recording a 1-2 minute video of your top-of-mind impressions from our Steam Page[/b][/url]! Doesn't matter if you already own the game or not, your feedback is vital for us to understand what our players want from a game like Learning Factory, so we could make it more awesome!

Anyway, back to those formerly unhappy cats. We noticed that the players were genuinely enjoying the process of catering to our feline overlords, but two questions were looming. First: how do we connect the Factory-building routines to the global story? And second: how do we make the players more interested and engaged by it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/416574f0ad32f4a07fd820750af6bb771b295d03.jpg[/img]

To answer the first question, we have introduced the almighty [b]Global Progression Scale[/b], which is visible on the Research Tree. It is a set of milestones that unlock next story chapters (previously they were unlocked upon researching certain technologies), but it's not just that. Milestones result in your Monument (the hi-tech brain hub of KOTOVOD Learning Factory) undergoing visual changes and upgrades. Additionally, they provide performance boosts, so you get to feel more powerful and important. 

But these are just the first steps. We will continue aligning the story with the gameplay, so you, the players, never hesitate about your final goal in the game: that is, [b]establishing Catopia on Mars[/b], a perfect feline society, where cats will live in abundance. The way this goal will be reached is one of the big things on our developer plates for the upcoming year, and the future is definitely bright! You can see that by the looks of our new key art:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/bcdad3feea9d5608259d81ea9e5adf6291398890.png[/img]

One of the other important insights that we've carried out within the past months: some of our players don't even know that Learning Factory is happening on Mars! Although those who have seen the golden medal ending of while True: learn() could have guessed where things were going… Anyway, we thought this is the perfect time to shed some light over the game's premise!

In the first half of XXI century humans have found out that cats are actually sentient (although extremely lazy) beings, who came to Earth from outer space. After establishing contact via cat-human translation devices (developed with the power of machine learning), the two species teamed up to terraform Mars, effectively making the Red planet look green and lively. During the process, they were helped and guided by the mysterious cats from the I.L.L.U.M.I.N.A.T.I. (Interstellar Lazy Labor Union for Mars Integration and Never-ending Aspiration for Technological Innovations), a mysterious organization and keepers of ancient feline knowledge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8a11d6eedd6e926c59c4b394a26012b5b2ef7c71.png[/img]

But someone has apparently made it to Mars years ago. Having finished the terraforming process, interstellar colonists have been contacted by a Dr. Katz, who turned out to be a feline scientist and a participant of an experimental project, contemplated by one of the Earth's governments back in the XX century. The project was called KOTOVOD and it was, in essence, a factory for studying cats and making them happy.

The whole KOTOVOD project, in turn, was revolving around the ancient cat-shaped structure, now known as The Monument. Dr. Katz would never be able to rebuild and research it by himself, because, you know, he has paws instead of hands. That's why he teams up with a humble genius engineer from Earth in an effort to restore the Monument, discover the secrets of the feline race and establish Catopia on one planet (for starters).

[h2]What Else Is New[/h2]

[h3](Yet Another) Advertising Cat Gate
[/h3]
We were not planning any major content additions to the game, since the past couple of months was incrediblry rich with new mechanics, new buildings and nodes on the research tree. That doesn't mean, however, that we've got nothing to show! For one, here's our brand new Advertising Cat Gate:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/b3162fc8c9ebc655d09780c20b3e762f8a00e1bf.gif[/img]

The building, formerly known under that name, is now called Target Advertising Cat Gate. This fella here, is a little more humble: it doesn't allow you summon selected types of cats, but it does let you select a kind of goods (1 per a Gate!) and allocate promotional budget: if it's sufficient, a cat looking for that item of your choosing will be summoned to the Factory. Keep in mind that they might have other items on their shopping lists, too!

[h3]Holiday Stuff
[/h3]
Some of it is already in the game, other pieces are expected to appear shortly, but in general: the great and dreadful Holiday Season is upon us, meaning that Learning Factory is getting festive, just look at those cats:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/df25294669d6acbfc99d84d58aeabcccd969f8e7.jpg[/img]
Buildings, too:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/edc4d3f881543329060bbe374b6089beb7ba6769.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/216c3b0c427fe7bc3442594ee55d4b9d2c0f8ec4.png[/img]
[h2]2021 In Screenshots[/h2]

It’s been a wild year: Learning Factory got released in Early Access on Steam and has grown times as bigger since February… There was also this epic story with [url=https://ludenio.substack.com/p/learning-factory-edu-its-a-wrap]Learning Factory EDU[/url] which resulted in a dedicated version of the game for middle school students, which is [url=https://luden.io/lfedu]available for free to everyone[/url], along with teacher guides and examplary lesson plans… 

It's been a lot!

The time to properly reflect upon all of it will come a bit later: when we'll be celebrating our 1st year in Early Access next February. Until then, we've got a couple of other aces up our sleeves, but most importantly: we've got Holidays to kick back for a couple of days, before we rock on!

So for now, let's enjoy these last days of the year and spend a minute to scroll through this humble screenshot gallery, demonstrating how Learning Factory has been changing throughout this year:

notes.title: KOTOVOD Worker #42: Global Progression for Progressive Factory Building!
notes.content:
It is symbolic that this news is published in #42 of KOTOVOD Worker! '42' is the answer to Life, Universe and Everything... Dr. Katz and his team don't have an answer to this question yet, but their latest invention certainly adds more meaning to the life on Mars!

Global Progression Scale demonstrates what needs to be done as we keep moving towards singularity! It is marked with milestones, which also come with bonuses for Learning Factory performance. It is a great help for KOTOVOD's engineers, as they can now stop bothering about puny human questions, such as the meaning of life: they have a scale to progress on! And the answer to all questions is, as usual: get back to work!

Get back to work we shall! Glory to Science! Glory to KOTOVOD!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

[h2]Version 0.10.49 Released![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/7f79f4514ccc2b7229d31a55761a53e12cd57bac.png[/img]
[h3]Global Progression Scale[/h3]
[list]
[*] New story chapters (a.k.a. comics) are now unlocked via achieving certain milestones on the scale (to be found in the Monument). Its main features:
[*] Major milestones: unlocked mainly by successfully serving cats
[*] Minor milestones: unlocked mainly by researching stuff on the Research Tree
[*] Unlocking milestones grants minor cumulative multipliers for various Factory mechanics: at this time, it's research performance and researcher parameters, and Hype levels. More unlock bonuses will be added in the future
[*] Some major milestones unlock additional gameplay mechanics (see below)
[*] Certain milestone unlock will let cat researchers reach out to you with their CVs. If your Dormitory is already full, you can stop accepting applications in the Tavern
[*] After certain milestone unlock, regularization will be applied to linear and polynomial models, which  will slightly increase their performance 
[*] Every milestone unlocked will visually change the Monument looks (graphics in this version are not final though)
[*] Deposit mechanics becomes available after reaching the first milestone

notes.title: Developer Diaries, Nov 2021: New Landscapes, New Mechanics And Some Rafts, Too
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/fa3117a10448df9fbef5ad4f6efff202e7a95e9c.jpg[/img]
Wow, has it really been just one month?

It almost seems too hard to believe, because SO many things have changed in the game since then - and we just can't stop working on adding more stuff, right as you are reading these lines.

Let's try and summarize the most important stuff that's happened recently, shall we?

[h2]New Trailer & Your Help is Needed![/h2]
[previewyoutube=nayzW9DjnHs;full][/previewyoutube]
This issue of developer diaries is accompanied with us releasing a whole new trailer for Learning Factory! It’s not just updating the graphics to the latest version, as we did before: we’ve filmed and edited it in accordance to the feedback we received from players and fellow indie developers. More cats, less uncertainty of what the game’s all about!

It was also part of our plan of re-inventing our Steam Page, to make the essence of the game clear to our future players. We’ve updated descriptions, screenshots, GIFs and whatnot… But we still ain’t 100% sure if the message we’re trying to communicate is clear enough.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

That’s where we need you, the community! We’d like to ask you to turn on your phone camera, point it on the screen with Learning Factory Steam page opened, and record 1-5 minutes of your impressions. We will make sure you get a honourable mention in the game’s credits, as this feedback helps us improve the game tremendously! 

If you’re ready to participate, you can find all the required info (along with a sample video) in [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/u/1/d/e/1FAIpQLSe7ugjWr3qnH2DY-fiJ6kz-BzcVdy1g7wPVdlfOd2QxDvVq8w/viewform?usp=sf_link][b]this Google form[/b][/url].

[h2]Rivers, Lakes and Rafts[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/1fc6bb663c95ec2dce761eb3eba675b923a55ee2.jpg[/img]
Previously, KOTOVOD was standing confidently on a huge chunk of land. It could definitely use some landscape. We have lots of plans for making the landscape of the game more diverse and interesting. The coolest things (like, biomes!) are expected to start emerging a bit later on, but you can get the taste of what's coming - that's what newly introduced lakes and rivers are for.

As it sometimes happens with us, we were not planning to implement water obstacles at this stage of development, but while we were designing Hardcore Tutorials (see below), we’ve been experimenting with terraforming tools in the Scenario Editor… At some point, we’ve added a river just for the hell of it… and it looked SO good on the map, it was an instant keeper! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/62bb043b985a1ad9f05784a60d94f82a335bd9e6.jpg[/img]

So, these days rivers are present on the campaign map (starting from version 0.10.45; if your saved game is from an older version, you’d need to start a new campaign), along with a bunch of watery map presets for the Freeplay mode. Feel free to experiment with them, they’re adding a whole new level of challenge for your logistics skills!

Of course, rivers can be easily crossed under the ground (for now, that is), but we’ve also introduced a new tool to help you on the surface: please welcome the mighty ‘Beaverborn’ Raft! It's built of Wood, it's crafted in 'Terraforming' tab and it supports Optic Cables and Transporters, along with your character! Use it wisely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/4b6f64b0410f8990f6cb4cbc2389a0a1d202b047.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hardcore Tutorials[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/e6940660ebd87a3f18c0b0b4351086f9b30cfa81.jpg[/img]
Hopefully, we all can agree: lengthy tutorials are just BORING. We respect our players and their time, that’s why we are trying to make that mandatory part of the game as compact as is reasonably possible.

Still, we’ve found out that some players have issues with understanding some later stage, more complicated game mechanics. It’s totally on us, as it is our job as developers - to make the game comprehensive and comfortable for you. We’ll keep improving UX, and in the meantime - please feel free to check our new ‘Tutorials’ section in the main menu. 

There you will find answers to the hottest questions! How to build a tunnel? How to connect machine learning models into networks? How to disconnect them?! And if you’re completely clueless, there’s a ‘Factory 101’ tutorial, which helps you learn the ropes of your campus. See? We’ve got you covered!

Let us know if there are any other issues you’d like us to clear out? There’s [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url] for that!

[h2]Deposit[/h2]
Of course, all money from sales in Cat Stores will ultimately be used for funding researches and pushing cat science forward. However, it used to be that all money were automatically spent on funding ongoing research projects. But what if you were looking to save money for hiring that genius of a cat researcher? Or maybe you just wanted to get filthy rich?!

Previously, the only way to accumulate money was to either put research on hold or become super effective and generate way more income than you were spending. But from now on, you’re welcome to redistribute some of your funds to your Deposit. It’s very simple:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/436e227cb751ff03ea90e91b2a38e2dad81758f9.jpg[/img]

1 - Click ‘Deposit’ button in the Inventory
2 - Choose the share of your income that will be stored on your Deposit (sorry for the copywriting, that money definitely isn’t free, but earned with your hard work! We’ll fix it in the next update)
3 - If required, select the limit of money to be accumulated on your Deposit
4 - You can also instantly transfer half or all your money from your Deposit to working funds, and vice versa

What would you like to spend that precious dough on? Don’t hesitate to send us your ideas, we’re always happy to discuss them as we’re thinking of more ways to use them in the game. But there’s that one feature we were planning to add from the very beginning of the development…

[h2]Ads[/h2]
Are you familiar with feeling that frustration, when certain goods are just sitting in your Storages, because cats who are supposed to buy them, just don’t arrive from the Gates often enough? Well, there now is a solution! They say you need to spend money to earn money, so please welcome the newly invented Advertising Cat Gate! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/f37227631015a43196db68a5c2384d45581ae753.gif[/img]

Not only it brings cats to your Factory, it allows you place paid ads in the cat internet, giving you a chance to invite kitties of your choosing! Since it’s the future here at KOTOVOD, you don’t need to other with coming up with ad campaign concept and reaching your audience: just throw some money into the Advertising Cat Gate, and let computers do the job! Follow these easy steps to success:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/249d589bddb9ed6c14d07bea818615bbee1ea6d0.jpg[/img]

1 - Select one or more desired cat types
2 - Choose the amount of money per ad. Obviously, the more demanding cats won't click on some cheap banner, so plan accordingly
3 - Watch your campaign unfolding! If a cat has clicked an ad, that kitty will emerge from the Gate
4 - Remember that you can pause your campaign at any time
5 - The part of ad mechanics, involving [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simulated_annealing]simulated annealing[/url], will be revealed a bit later on. For now we’re looking into several options: our initial plan was to implement it in the form of procedurally generated ad banner… But this very likely to change

[h2]What Else Is New?[/h2]
Smaller awesome stuff is happening here and there. Our Graphic Card Assembler is now animated, adding even more motivation for you to research it (in addition to being able to produce video cards in unlimited amounts):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8562ddfbf066ab0fba2a01320c31495393f5eab4.gif[/img]

Perks for cat researchers in Labs have also been made more comprehensive. Also, no more spawning of scientists with mutually exclusive perks! Some of them can also get productivity boosts if receiving certain kinds of data from Data Storages:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/e6163be1eaa9c574219fecacf10ef131180c14a9.png[/img]

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8a11d6eedd6e926c59c4b394a26012b5b2ef7c71.png[/img]
We’re now working on a rather experimental mechanic, that goes under the code name ‘The Flask’. To describe what it does is not at all an easy task. Its mission is to bring closer the gameplay and the story. The way we see it, it should become the narrative center of the game — for those who think that chill cat Factory building is not enough and keep asking ‘Why?’… As we see it now, it will be a series of gameplay challenges, that push the story forward and impact your Factory both in terms of gameplay and visuals.

We won’t go into too much details at the moment, because, as it happens in video game development, things might turn out unexpectedly and the concept will change, maybe even more than once. For now, just know that we are thinking on how to add more sense to what’s happening around KOTOVOD

In the meantime, our artist Sergei from Siberia, keeps making the game prettier for you! For the past week, he’s work is all about METAL (and making new key art for Learning Factory, too):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/fc436cf89b6599c89ad25ab711fa1c8ceedf7fd6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/085346a52d9a4aef17f14b6b8a330a8abc1a74be.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8bcab4e76c125a420604dbaa977baa27af7d0190.jpg[/img]

And here's your monthly portion of our bosses' photos:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/373aeeb30885e4d1b37c8575376db77682b3100e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/41e5d978846b6df2bf78be4e8faaa73b532faa20.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/6810f851f553404588b8cd15413a5a08a318c324.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/9bdce4b8ed123ae0357bc8f3049506c783bf531d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/dfa91612492ad6800dc54919d2ddb22769af404a.jpg[/img]

See you in a month with yet another report, friendly engineers! But if you've got thoughts to share, there's no point in waiting, come talk to us directly:

[list]

[*] [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url]
[/list]

P.S. If you want to keep an eye our progress closer, don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/]follow Learning Factory[/url] on our Steam page and never miss an update again!

notes.title: KOTOVOD Worker #41: Deposits & Paid Ads to Boost Sales
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/66331da461466eeb1be4b7ea7cd002a21fcc7b22.png[/img]
Everyone knows that all cats coming to KOTOVOD have funds of unknown origin. Sometimes they're eager to spend a very limited amount of it, but the fact still stands: cats don't need to care about their income. Our engineers, however, need to keep track of it at all times: the money is required for maintaining the wellbeing of precious scientists, working tirelessly to push the feline science forward! Without their pay checks, they immediately get very tired and proceed into slumber.

Since KOTOVOD is functioning within the market economy, Dr. Katz commanded to issue more control to the engineers over the Factory's financial management. From now on, scientists are allowed to reserve certain amounts of money from turning into salaries, in order to accumulate funds for more strategic steps: such as, expanding the Dormitory for hiring more scientists.

The engineers can also use that money to attract more customers: thanks to the new type of Cat Gate, it is now possible to bring certain types of cats who would definitely appreciate your current selection of goods. 

Needless to say, no extra funds will be used to increase the engineers' salaries, as they work on plain enthusiasm and their love towards cats.

Glory to science! Glory to KOTOVOD!

notes.title: Developer Diaries, Oct 2021: On New Mechanics and Stage 1 Completion
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/141c91ad8e59e8685ec040ab5d40823cef09a81f.jpg[/img]

Oh hi there!

It feels aa bit overwhelming as we're writing these lines, since this week marks the [b]completion of Stage 1 of Learning Factory's Early Access[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory

(pause for applause and fanfare)

Thanks to your love and support, we have really pushed our game forward in the past 8 months! The game has changed drastically, and not only in terms of content: we're talking about more stable, more optimized, more user friendly version of Learning Factory, which lets you spend dozens of hours, chilling and building the KOTOVOD of your (cats') dreams.

But hey, we've added tons of content as well! This iteration of our Dev Diaries is dedicated to the most important changes of the past 3 months.


[h2]Hype[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/2a06e4ffdf174405ae9a6d28c0177cd219b08c14.jpg[/img]
Cats used to simply roam to your Factory in an endless stream of happy customers. Well, we decided to make it closer to what's happening on actual markets (despite the fact that we're talking about a game where you build cat factory on Mars).

You see, your cats are not alone now. They have friends and they are very eager to share experience from visiting your Factory with those friends.

Upon trying to purchase something, a cat has a chance of recommending your Stores to a friend. Or, in case they haven't found what their hearts desire, they can talk a friend out of visiting your Factory!

Word of meow is one powerful thing, and it influences your flow of catstomers now! Of course, you can always build another Cat Gate which will bring more cats to your campus, but if you want a steady cash flow, you better make sure those cats find what they come for.

This system was inspired by startup management mechanics from our previous game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/619150/while_True_learn/][b]while True: learn()[/b][/url], but this time hype levels actually depend on your skills of handling cat requests. In short, that means: get to work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/3dade06a282ea2832c1ed504718ae7a29b931648.gif[/img]

Additionally, keep track on 'Shopaholic Invasion' events, which happen randomly from time to time and bring oodles of cats to your Factory at once! Used to be, only Grandma Cats were arriving during this event, but we honestly, it just didn't feel right: why only grandmas would come off as shopaholics? So another (random) type of cats will be joining the swarm every time. And, of course, these events might change your Hype levels dramatically, and fast.

[h2]Pyramid of requests[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/4a0f831a09dc4321b9a963d22264b7689048e349.jpg[/img]

Another brand new mechanics from version 0.10 is called ‘Satisfaction Pyramid’, and is inspired by [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maslow%27s_hierarchy_of_needs]Abraham Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs[/url]. In the world of Learning Factory it actually shows your impact to improving the feline society!

You can find it in the ‘Cats’ tab in the Wiki (‘H’). Here’s how it works.

Different kinds of cats want certain kinds of items. These items are sorted in the Pyramid by their priority to respective types of cats.

The more satisfied requests on a lower level of the pyramid, the higher the chances of a cat to request an item from higher levels. [b](figure A)[/b]

On the left you can see how many requests for respective items were recently satisfied and the total amount of recent requests of this type [b](figure B)[/b]

If all levels are unlocked, there's a chance for a cat to upgrade into a more advanced and demanding upon appearing from the Cat Gate, given that requests on lower levels are being met [b](figure C)[/b]. You can also see how many cats recently advanced [b](figure D)[/b]

If a level of the pyramid is not yet unlocked, that means these cats are buying stuff they need someplace else (for now, at least), and it’s your job to find out what they want and provide!

[h2]Upgrades[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/cef78e0a6d566d2de5c8384f94a71255469f7767.jpg[/img]
Buildings and other research project are now subject of improvement! This long-waited feature will help you boost your Factory's performance and/or unlock various gameplay features. See the image above:

Those blue-turning-gray icons [b](figure A)[/b] represent upgrades, available for your research projects. You can hover your mouse cursor over an Upgrade's icon to see exactly what it does [b](figure B)[/b], and you can see requirements for unlocking it in the lower right corner [b](figure C)[/b].

But that's not it. Upon unlocking, the Upgrade must be researched, just like any other object on the Tree ([b]figure D[/b]). Mind that certain buildings might have more than just one Upgrade for unlocking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/5903b5303c2d66e122ba2ef5d9f19dbe7ead0c39.jpg[/img]

Sounds like a lot of hoops to jump through, but the result is definitely worth it, as it can unlock alternative recipes for crafting, and even new buildings. Look at this handsome T-shaped Splitter that is now yours to unlock:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/06ed44791d3057be527cbe85390df010da62f3d7.gif[/img]

[h2]Business Requests and Specialized Stores[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/5f08033fa8506e4d74ec6c7085c3349d1c326600.jpg[/img]
You fellas would love more Cat Stores at your Factory, wouldn't you? Don't be shy: we know that setting the appropriate number of Stores for each cat type is one of the strategies for maximizing your profits. 

And this mechanics has just become deeper! You see, there are now cats who don't even care about their Pyramid of requests: all they want is to buy a bunch of goods from one of 5 goods categories: they might be craving for [b]Food[/b], [b]Materials[/b], [b]Essential[/b], [b]Luxury[/b] or [b]Tech[/b] stuff. Now, cats are well known to be mysterious creatures, so we're still trying to figure out why these cats behave this way. We're suggesting that they're buying those things for their business needs (what business can be run by cats? Send us your thoughts in the comments!)

How do you make these cats happy? First, you better separate them from the rest of the bunch. There's a Business Request Splitter on the Research Tree, tailored exactly for that task.

Then, research and build our new Specialized Smart Store (seen on the picture above), select the category it will be selling items from, and make sure to provide! Huge profits can be generated by using these Stores, but some serious production optimization will most likely be required. Can you figure it out?

With this feature, we were trying to add another layer to the gameplay: adding yet another type of cat to go to another Smart Store seemed like doing more of the same thing (we already have 7 of those!), so instead, we've come up with a whole new type of request. Dividing cats only by their type is not always enough anymore: cats of all kinds can spawn with business requests for any category. 

It might not sound like a big deal, but in reality they provide a great deal of a challenge since these Stores become available at late stages of the game, when your Factory is supposedly huge and production chains get weird. Give it a shot and let us know how you like it!

[h2]Harvesting[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/ff6d11a812546e80536ce937677ec9418c9c1bdd.gif[/img]
This one is simple, but might come in handy! If you need just a couple of those Cotton plants or some Wood from them Trees, there's no need to chop down the poor thingies! Instead, press your Left Mouse Button on a plant to simply harvest smaller amount of respective resource. Don't worry, it'll grow back soon enough!

The boring explanation of these mechanics is that we wanted to give the players another option of handling resources and increase their sense of control. But most importantly, clicking and harvesting stuff just feels [i]so good[/i]!

Speaking of left mouse button: we've added a rather cool feature that turn Transporter drawing placement mode on by default. Simple press and hold LMB and get creative! Like: I did not pet her, I DID NOT!..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/7faf4a3db73e3de24e55b006337269f779e5ad2d.gif[/img]

[h2]New Story chapter[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/416574f0ad32f4a07fd820750af6bb771b295d03.jpg[/img]
A handful of pick for our artist, a huge leap for Learning Factory! This new set of comic strips completes our list of features planned for Stage 1 of Early Access. But look, we're already halfway through Stage 2:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8943a88fea8ecae7ce1afd0fb4f7283ea250526c.png[/img]

This roughly concludes the list of new mechanics in the game, but that's just the top of the iceberg! Listing all the changes made within these 8 months would probably blow up Steam, so let's just highlight the most interesting stuff:

[h2]Researchers for hire[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/73ec81038a20d60a6abac166673e17a8ddeff5d6.jpg[/img]
Earlier this year, we've reveal the truly unique nature of our cat researchers. With version 0.10, we've added even more individual traits and expanded the Tavern and Dormitory mechanics in general.

They got new looks! They got new perks! They now upgrade their parameters while they research! Alternatively, if you feel particularly rich, you can upgrade the Tavern itself and get more competent (and expensive) candidates for your Research Labs.

Of course, as it is with harvesting mechanics, the true purpose of these improvements is to let you to check out more goofy cats. That's what we use it for, at least:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/0cae1c25d9dd055d7a3cf09894f92bfb2d5cb5ad.gif[/img]

[h2]New Cat Types[/h2]
If you've read this far, you must be tired by now. Or maybe you've just wanted more cool pics? In any case, let's watch some cool pics! Check out 2 new types of cats at Learning Factory! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/61fafb0a653d2adea510e51d88e71fb16981d905.png[/img]
[h3]Grandma Cats[/h3]
A.k.a. "the babushkas" ("babushka" stands for "grandma" in Russian, if you didn't know that already). They're the cutest cats at any Factory, looking for your typical grandma stuff: apples for making their amazing jam, cotton for their knitting and such!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/474059600d06f4b779e7296516774774145477bf.png[/img]
[h3]Tech Cats[/h3]
Their desires are easily readable from their looks! They crave anything high-tech and rumors are, they consist of pure energy!

[h2]New Buildings/Researches/Goods[/h2]
Tl;dr : there's so much new stuff! The main game changer is the 2 new types of metals (Copper and Gold), which are used for crafting advanced items. And you'll need new machinery for mining and processing it, of course:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/532004bcdd28fdd6a7cae29b53fe541cfe7be7a0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/fc2c00cc3aee0950375f9b2b96c7f78a0e84e72d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/96a1811c02f9d18a263d53089f3b61191879dc00.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/e1e46ed430ba8db21889c26fb0ed8ab5d2cbf4e6.jpg[/img]

And, of course, Learning Factory provides probably one of the easiest way to get a top notch graphic adapter:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/84990851d1449daf06af09402f0e04e55b007b8b.jpg[/img]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/7f56c93fbea9d16a03255d8847544513c569888d.jpg[/img]
Improving user experience is what's on our minds these days. We're now working on a dedicated Tutorial mode, which will contain a set of scenarios, designed to help the new players learn the ropes of Learning Factory. But, of course, that's not the only thing we're working on. Above is the prototype vision of new map layouts. Rivers! Maybe even hills? Let us know if you want a more diverse landscape on Mars!

[h2]Bonus: Cute Cat Photos[/h2]
Life goes on. We're developing Learning Factory, you're enjoying it at your homes (or so we hope). And for cats... everything is going by the plan: lazy passtime and inventing new ways for getting munchies from those bald apes who consider themselves their owners. Check out this selection of our team's cats and see for yourself: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/9032c4933f03dc0c292682aebb75cea78ab981f5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/7439e91e3ca03e840a5230a585e6b6815d743501.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/d032f39d435897daef1d8624d0ac7747e1a0d834.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/3bc0894878640f55986ed2264ca4885e444adca3.jpg[/img]

That's it for today, folks! Please let us know how you like this new, text version of our dev diaries! And by all means, play some awesome games this weekend! Just don't forget to share your experience with us: join our merry bunch of players on our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url].

P.S. If you want to keep an eye our progress closer, don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/]follow Learning Factory[/url] on our Steam page and never miss an update again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/4cff23bb315d00c56db53ad0efa749d6c6892a6c.gif[/img]

notes.content:

notes.title: KOTOVOD Worker #35: Techno Leap!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/cd2d01e06b6af8b626b9f8623b96a24c48819a3c.png[/img]
The sun is once again shining upon Mars, its rays reflected by equally bright faces of KOTOVOD workers, Dr. Katz himself not included. For it is today when major machinery upgrade takes place on Learning Factory!
KOTOVOD cat scientists have been working tirelessly to study the needs of cat customers for the past few months. It is very well known that human wants are infinite, but cats' wants, apparently, go far deeper and are infinite on so many levels!
This is why KOTOVOD has to deliver. And by KOTOVOD we mean our brave engineers, who now are at a truly heroic task of finding resources, researching new production buildings, creating supply chains and figuring out logistics and much, much more (with no extra payment, as usual). When it comes to making cats happier, no amount of work is excessive, Please get yourselves acquainted with the list of new available improvements to your factories and proceed to working! Glory to science! Glory to KOTOVOD!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

[h2]Version 0.10.36 Released[/h2]
[h3]New resources and items:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a5fc2da38f66aa366509dfc3fb4da72c7416f604.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Copper Veins, to be mined for Copper - base resource for crafting tech-producing buildings and scientific buildings
[*] Gold Veins, to be mined for Gold - a mid-game resource for crafting tech items and machine learning buildings. Cannot be mined manually
[*] Catnip Algae - like a catnip, but under the water. To keep it away from cats (for a short while)
[*] Juice - Snoop Katt's Catnip Juice: the ultimate soft drink for partying hard
[*] Bubble Gum - comes in two flavors: pure oats and shrimp-flavored oats
[*] Microchips - for building high-level machine learning models. They're kinda huge though
[*] Blings - who knows why cats want trinkets, but it's now your job to supply them, too
[*] Graphic Adapters - for building  high-level machine learning models. Not that you can buy one in real life, can you?
[*] Hammocks - they're anti-grav, too! Because why not
[*] Concrete - a necessary basis for mid-game buildings. This description doesn't get more concrete than that
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/446263e60d91e8b47eb22d13797f0cf0dade56ac.jpg[/img]
[h3]New cat types:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Techno Cat - in search for everything high-tech
[*] Granny Cat - the cutest cats that can come by your Factory (but they only do so during Shopaholic Invasions)
[/list]
[h3]New buildings:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/532004bcdd28fdd6a7cae29b53fe541cfe7be7a0.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Algae Harvester (animated)
[*] Catnip Juice Brewery
[*] Bubble Gum Mixer
[*] Gold Digger
[*] Dredge (also for Gold)
[*] Microchip Assembler
[*] Graphic Adapter Assembler
[*] Business Request Splitter
[*] Specialized Smart Stores (for business requests): larger shelves, but sells only one category of goods
[*] Boom fences
[*] Small Catnip Algae Plant
[/list]
[h3]New mechanics: Hype[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/84990851d1449daf06af09402f0e04e55b007b8b.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Cat's don't simply walk to the Factory anymore
[*] If a cat's request was satisfied, they might advise your Factory to a friend
[*] If a cat has left dissatisfied, they might talk a friend out of visiting your Factory
[*] The more cats were invited, the more will come, eventually
[*] Cats can only call friends of the same kind as themselves
[*] Cat Gates are now available for crafting since the beginning of the game
[*] Shopaholic Invasions now happen from time to time, bringing cats with unusual requests
[*] In the campaign, Hype mechanics only activates upon completing tutorial
[/list]
[h3]New mechanics: Pyramid of requests[/h3]
[list]
[*] Each cat type has a selection of favored goods, ranged by levels of value. If the requests from the lower level are not met, cats won't be asking for goods from upper levels
[*] When all request levels are satisfied, a cat might advance to another, more complicated kind of cat, with more complicated requests
[/list]
[h3]New mechanics: Harvesting [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a72297e713ba1be73ae602295f1670865e545167.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Pressing LMB on trees and such lets harvest a plant without destroying it (but brings less resource units)
[*] Scattered objects can now be picked by either LMB or RMB
[*] A text hints are displayed while harvesting/dismantling/picking up stuff
[/list]
[h3]New Mechanics: Business requests[/h3]
[list]
[*] Certain cats with a demand for big amounts of goods from specific categories, will now be appearing on the Factory. Supposedly this is for business needs (or so cats claim anyway)
[*] Business requests might include goods, not present in the pyramid for respective cat type
[*] All basic Stores now have 5 slots for goods
[/list]
[h3]New mechanics: Tavern, Dormitory, researches and scientists[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tavern can now be upgraded. As it becomes a more and more exquisite spot on Mars, more advanced cats tend to come by. They're more demanding in terms of onboarding packages and might ask for certain items if you want to hire them
[*] Alternatively, you can nurture your own dream team of scientists, as they now receive experience in research categories they work at, proportional to their personal input in said research
[*] Many new perks available for generation of scientists, including those influencing the amount of experience and the final quality of articles
[*] New outfits and hairstyles available for scientists!
[*] Every next room you unlock in the Dormitory becomes progressively more expensive
[/list]
[h3]UI & UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Input and output zones are more visually highlighted when placing a building
[*] Building entrances now reflect efficiency and possibility of production from each tile
[*] Entrances now reflect possibility of laying an item on a tile
[*] Transporter placement by drawing mechanics has been improved
[*] Transporter placement by drawing is now turned on by default
[*] Classic transporter placement method is activated by pressing and holding 'Ctrl'
[*] All buildings can be placed over Transporter lines
[*] When building a structure over a locked tile, the latter will be highlighted with a lock icon
[*] Cat Splitters and Cat Manipulators are now copied along with cat settings
[*] Cat Splitters and Cat Manipulators can no longer be set up for picking cat types not yet discovered by the player
[*] Information about certain items is now given from the start of the game
[*] Information about items becomes unlocked upon researching the building
[*] Wiki articles display recipes for production buildings
[*] Tooltips improved throughout the game
[*] In construction tooltip shows the missing buildings and resources and does not get out of the range of screen
[*] The panel of crafted buildings can now display two rows of buildings if there are too many of them
[*] Minimap has two sizes and can be flipped back and forth
[*] The process of loading is displayed while loading
[*] Scenario editor now has item filtering category
[*] Clear research queue button added
[*] Clear Store stats button added
[*] Clear stat for machine learning button added
[*] Machine learning does not display items and cats not involved in training the Model
[*] Cotton spreading slightly slowed down
[*] Stores now display items that were requested but did not fit on the shelves
[*] Statistics has items, cats and additional data divided into groups, improved visual 
[*] Events about items and cats now have tooltips and can take straight to the Wiki
[*] All buildings tab has been added to construction
[*] Filter by buildings added to the Wiki
[/list]
[h3]Optimization and bugs[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/ff6710c2c77179a8c13fbc86be9c77b143c09d76.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Global game optimization
[*] Game saving optimization
[*] Game loading optimization
[*] Optimized play on ultra wide screens
[*] Machine learning optimization
[*] Tons of bugs fixed
[/list]
[h3]Story[/h3]
[list]
[*] Starting comic strip slightly changed
[*] New slide in the comics featuring Dr. Katz
[*] Gazillion of new achievements
[*] Including hidden achievements
[*] Including community suggested achievements
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] All localizations updated
[*] Especially Chinese
[*] Turkish fonts updated
[*] Updated visuals and interfaces for ultra wide screens
[*] New unique scientist cats
[*] New looks and outfits for cat scientists
[*] New apparels for cat customers
[*] Halloween menu theme. More Halloween stuff coming up in the next updates
[/list]
[h3]Roadmap Milestones Reached:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Specializing Shops
[*] New Cat-Researchers
[*] Cat Request Classification Model
[*] Educational edition of the Game
[*] Advanced Research II
[*] Educational Materials III
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/149ac6609cd73fc930fd0dce665eb040a21a2c40.png[/img]

Let us know what you think and by all means, share your factory screenshots with us on [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/learningfact0ry]Twitter[/url]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a9bd8a1c27c5f77965a99521ac4c83f6b92aa3f8.jpg[/img]
Hey there, incredible engineers!

We're very busy at the moment, as the release of next big (and we mean [b]BIG[/b], in bold!) update for [b]Learning Factory[/b] is just around the corner, and we're happy to share some awesome WIP pictures with you!

But let's get the only peice of bad news out of the way first:

[h2]Your saves from v0.9.32 and under won't work after the update next week[/h2]
We'll try and create a separate branch of the game for those of you who want to continue playing with your current Faactories. We also sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but that's Early Access life...

Ok, back to cool stuff! As you probably know by now, the biggest change about the upcoming update is a bunch of new resources, craftable goods and, naturally, wicked machinery for producing stuff for cats on Mars. What will KOTOVOD have to offer, come the update? How about a Microchip Maker:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/e1e46ed430ba8db21889c26fb0ed8ab5d2cbf4e6.jpg[/img]
[i]It will be very useful for crafting computer stuff![/i]

Or maybe you'd like to make some anti-gravitational hammocks:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/ddae8639e57f74b2df3a5fc84d020ff1f6342764.jpg[/img]
[i]We've got you![/i]

What does this thing do? Well, it extracts gold from under the water:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/96a1811c02f9d18a263d53089f3b61191879dc00.jpg[/img]
[i]It's name is William Seaward Burrows, in case you were wondering.[/i]

And here's what we need gold for:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/fc2c00cc3aee0950375f9b2b96c7f78a0e84e72d.jpg[/img]
[i]Behold the Bling Machine![/i]

These things are all a work in progress, so let's don't rush things... Or shall we? Do you want to check (most of) the new stuff, like, right now? We'll, if you insist,
[h3]Learning Factort 0.10 update is available for testing in Steam Betaa branch,[/h3]
feel free to check it out! There will be bugs, there will be translation shennanigans, but all in all we encourage our bravest players to play it and generate some data so we could fix potential bugs and provide a more polished experience to our players by September 23.

notes.title: Status Update: Praise Again the Machines
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/916c00290f86efbc7a0db5a87c685929e50b8ed1.jpg[/img]

Hey there, handsome engineers!

We hope you're doing fine, because we have awesome news for you (as we usually do!). 

That big [b]Learning Factory[/b] update you've all been waiting for -- is coming into it's final form, slowly, but steadily. As you might already know, it's aimed to bring your way a whole bunch of new research projects, new machinery to build, and new awesome goods to treat your catty customers!

We have freshly squeezed juice:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/a5fc2da38f66aa366509dfc3fb4da72c7416f604.jpg[/img]

We have our own juice brewing machines:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/42a784c30dda6a5706fcde76b5bf859e263bf385.jpg[/img]

We haave blings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8c2f3efdd525123a19a7ba916bfe491ec1a771f2.jpg[/img]

And we have not one, but TWO machines for mining gold -- both on the land and in the sea:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/532004bcdd28fdd6a7cae29b53fe541cfe7be7a0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/5cb469e4c60d8f642d5c70496e8aecb864443a04.jpg[/img]

As usual, we must remind, that all this art is a work in progress: because the final, animated versions of it will look much more beautiful (as it always does!).

Want to discuss this awesome stuff in action? Mybe even influence us while we're developing it? Well, there are options. First, we encourage you to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url] (as we always do, and we're always happy to see new faces there!). And second, you can join us live tomorrow:

[h2]Live Stream this Friday![/h2]

As we tend to do every fortnite, we're going on air this Friday afternoon, and you're invited! Please note that we're going to start [b]one hour earlier than usual[/b] this time:

[h3]September 10, [b]7am PST / 10am EST / 4pm CET[/b]![/h3]
Join us on the Steam page, or head to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ludenio]Twitch[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCsu9FcHUXo5bQ4HxDkwRFXw]YouTube[/url], we'll be monitoring all 3 chat rooms.

notes.title: Back to School, Everyone!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/29c07191505c29431c5bace6657c76d38e5c0d2e.jpg[/img]

As game devs around our 30s, we remember times when returning back to school promised a lot of boring pastimes. For many modern school children, it remains this way as of today.

But hey, as game devs around our 30s, we are also very much certain that learning new stuff is awesome, furthermore, it's a necessary condition of survival in the modern world. 

As game devs, we also believe that learning should in no way be boring. 

[url=https://luden.io/lfedu][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/4039ea0a423e5e06610a3da008abeb3d6267b55f.png[/img][/url]

For us, this summer was an exciting journey to creating Learning Factory EDU, a free version of Learning Factory, designed and packed to help improve problem solving skills for middle school learners - while introducing them to engineering practices along the way. If you haven't seen it yet, [url=https://luden.io/lfedu][b]you're very welcome to download it for free from our website[/b][/url].

But it was not only about developing the product itself: for us the most important was the possibility to meet with all kinds of exciting thinkers, transforming the world into its better state with help from video games! We have met teachers, non profit miracle workers and ed tech entrepreneurs in our [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL2qcMTL4wobqzy6eL1SUmI65Qlw1q71lO]video series[/url]

[url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL2qcMTL4wobqzy6eL1SUmI65Qlw1q71lO][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/8165ceb2f4e13cf219ad191d14a5c4a6ff159d41.png[/img][/url]

Please share a link to [url=https://luden.io/lfedu]Learning Factory EDU[/url] to anyone interested in applying video games in education, as we're looking for teachers and parents, willing to play it along with their learners and share feedback. This will help us turn LF EDU into a razor-sharp tool carving a way towards new knowledge!

Happy new school year!

Tell us about what you've learnt this summer?

notes.title: Status Update: The Future of Educational Games, Cool Stuff at Learning Factory
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/bed57c61eb942683f24d98086572a082ef91ffd6.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone! How's your week? As for us, we are, unsurprisingly, still working on [b]Learning Factory[/b], both regular and the EDU version for middle schools (as part of our collaboration with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1150090/announcements/detail/3020207373023665398]Games For Change[/url]). And while the former still has much, much development and polishing to happen (see some exciting WiP stuff below), Learning Faactory EDU is coming to its final shape. It's time for talking about insights and showing stuff!

[h2]LF EDU Dev Diaries: A Kid's Perspective On (What's Wrong With) Educational Products[/h2] 
[previewyoutube=6AzYQxBvdmU;full][/previewyoutube]
In this episode we're meeting with Paul Darvasi, an educator with 20+ years of experience, who's now doing a visionnaire job, turining mainstream and indie [url=http://www.ludiclearning.org/]games into school lessons[/url]. But most importantly, we're joined by his 11-years old son Max, who has a rather fresh perspective on what exactly is wrong with today's "educational games" and how games can and will be transforming classrooms.
If you're interested in games for education, we encourage you to treat yourself with this optimistic episode!

notes.title: KOTOVOD Worker #34: What Does the Cat Say?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/452571baf1a00d01f475aadd061f1ddfda473942.png[/img]
Inventing the magnificent Babel Fish Chip allowed human beings communicate with their furry feline companions.

But what about cat thoughts?

Finding the way to this mysterious domain could be crucial to deeper understanding the nature of cats. And a breakthrough might just be around the corner! Today, KOTOVOD Administration has launched the experimental mind-reading field, that allows literally read feline minds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/56f226230a7b8ebb934f1f4885190792489c7998.png[/img]

(The design of the device has been safety-tested many times and is considered 100% safe, for cats, at least)

The field is operating at a very low altitude, so engineers need to zoom their cameras in in order to be able to read cat thoughts.

Naturally, privacy security comes first, which is why mind reading field is only capable of reading only silly gibberish that randomly fleshes through cats' superior consciousness.

Glory to science! Great discoveries await!

notes.title: KOTOVOD Worker #33: Time-Bending Production
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/177374b127474473aa6507ac39e8c27fe324a280.png[/img]
Science is glorious! Things that were considered sorcery or plain miracles a couple of decades ago, are now applied everywhere!

But the science needs to be put to service of greater goals. Such as, for example - making Mars a thriving paradise for cats (and maybe humans, occasionally).

This is why Dr. Katz has introduced the access to time-bending techonlogies for all the engineers. Using the breakthrough feature our R&D Dept elegantly refers to as 'Pause' stops all the processes on the factory momentarily, while still allowing engineers to run around, collect resources, craft, build, rebuild and optimize! 

It is important to underline, that working while time stopped is not considered overtime work and therefore is not additionally compencated. Not like engineers' work was compencated in the first place.

But KOTOVOD administration takes great care in their workers' efficiency, which is why it has also introduce Transporter Assemblers, which allows humans to spend less time on constructing those belts and more time on actual work, which is, as usual, pleasing cats.

Science be praised! Glory to KOTOVOD!

notes.title: KOTOVOD Worker #32: Cat-Calling Discoveries + LIVE-STREAM
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/3acbbaeb2f188df69ad77377f36ff7e51983dfba.png[/img]
Cats are truly mysterious creatures!

Thousands of years side by side with humans. Learning how to understand each other. Bringing Mars to life, side by side. And yet, we still know so little about them!

How do you like to call your cat companion? Mr Whiskers? Fluffytoes? 

It has recently been discovered, that pre-historic cats (the ones allegedly came from Mars hundreds of thousands years ago), whose traces are now being discovered at various locations on Earth, have not been using names in a sense that we understand them. Instead, it is now believed that they were communicating telepathically within a shared mental field, every member of which was recognized by a unique pattern, assigned to each member of the field by their origin, fur color, style of napping and their taste for different kinds of snacks.

How would these names sound, were they translated into symbols recognized by humans? Well, apparently, before the invention of the Babyl Fish Chip, cats were trying to spell out their names while walking on human desktop keyboards. So if you've ever seen your cat 'accidentally' typing something like 'HGYUj767567uyhvcxdfguhij', then perhaps your furry friends were merely trying to properly introduce themselves.

In the light of this new discovery, more and more cats are starting to refer their names as 'human tags', taking pride in their relation to their legendary ancestors. They still feel fine about us continuing to use them. So don't worry, just keep that food bowl full, silly human!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/0ef234ae48173704e6e81fbf19658fda9de42cdf.png[/img]

This week brought a whole bunch of exciting news to KOTOVOD Learning Factory! Ever since our management, in their eternal wisdom, has announced that R&D dept. is hiring new staff, the sales have skyrocketed, and so has the amount of data.

This calls in for introducing more powerful ML Models. Please meet Neural Network Model machine along with its genius cousin, Deep Neural Network Model machine:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/d708055b4f10d3da10816a8f7ffb9d66aab7b6dd.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/7acf803e5718f4355b22a7a9103bcd0ab2ca8b79.gif[/img]

These cutting edge technologies will help improve the data science at the Factory, for better customer service (and more money to fund our research!)

As if it wasn't enough, the first seeds of the I.L.L.U.M.I.N.A.T.I. brand new Hedges were delivered on Mars! These marvels of genetic engineering magically stop growing at some point, which not only makes them perfect decorations, but also helps withhold the legendary aggressive growth of Martian plants.

As if that wasn't enough too, KOTOVOD engineers now have access to advanced tools for factory building, which will allow more precision in designing your Learning Factories.

What are you waiting for, engineers? Go build some awesome stuff! We'll be in touch.

[h2]Version 0.9.27 Released[/h2]
[list]
[*] Scenario editor: you can now create all kinds of maps with different parameters
[*] Neural Networks! A brand new machine learning model in the game. It helps optimize the prices in stores, like Regressions do, but does so in a way more efficient way. Also, they look gorgeous
[*] Hedges: a new plant to help make your Factory look nicer and/or withhold the aggressive grows of other Martian plants. Why don't hedges grow and multiply though? That's a mystery, let us know if you have any ideas!
[*] Bug fixes
[*] EPIC HUGE MONSTROUS PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZAAAAAAAATION (the devs were very deliberate about writing it this way)
[*] And a brand new achievement!
[/list]

notes.title: Status Update: Introducing Learning Factory EDU
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/1b144b0f051fddc789d9dc1a918773dc58d39725.jpg[/img]

Wow, what a week, so many news! But first, let's get the reuglar things out of the way:

[h2]Hotfix 0.9.26 Released[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Performance optimization
[*] Added ability to lock buildings, preventing accidental removal
[/olist]

[h2]Live stream with devs this Friday[/h2]
We'll post a separate announcement tomorrow, but you know the drill:  [b]8am PST / 11am EST / 5pm CET[/b]! On [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ludenio]Twitch[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCsu9FcHUXo5bQ4HxDkwRFXw]YouTube[/url] and on our Steam page. Can't wait to see you there!

[url=https://ludenio.substack.com/p/learning-factory-edu-coming-to-schools][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/7eeb35d9774c2c8c66bb24597c74a489ff60c38c.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Presenting Learning Factory EDU[/h2]
Learning Factory has been [url=https://www.gamasutra.com/view/pressreleases/381769/Two_developers_chosen_to_receive_150k_and_STEM_their_games_for_edutainment.php]named one of the winners[/url] of the [b]STEM Your Game Challenge[/b], organized by leading non-profit gaming organization [url=https://gamesforchange.org]Games For Change[/url].

Which, in short, means one big thing: we will be developing a special educational version of our game, tailored to help teaching STEM through the power of scientific method, which is, in the words of great physicist Richard Feynman, [i]“a key to science”[/i].

[h3]What is Learning Factory EDU?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Modified, lightweight version of the main game, in which players/learners must find out, what cats really want;
[*] Includes 10 pre-made lessons, based on an innovative educational method “Phenomenon-based learning” which is validated by Finnish schools;
[*] Aims to teach children about production, automation, data, and the essence of scientific approach for solving problems;
[*] Co-designed with teachers (see below);
[*] Comes with a lesson-planning guide for teachers and a workbook for learners;
[*] It will be [b]totally free[/b]
[/list]
If you happen to be an educator yourself, or if you know a teacher who can use some new (fun and free) educational tool, please [b]subscribe to our [url=https://ludenio.substack.com/p/learning-factory-edu-coming-to-schools]blog and newsletter[/url] [/b] or contact us in any other way: we're looking for as much feedack as possible, to make a really quality educational game!

We'll post more details about Learning Factory EDU in the upcoming weeks. And naturally, it will benefit the main game as well ;) Stay tuned to learn, how!

notes.title: KOTOVOD Worker #30: Catisfaction Intensifies!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/30326830ac8146f8fc542fb6bce6be4169fb7bd7.png[/img]

Since KOTOVOD administration issued a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1150090/announcements/detail/2996562204118990442][b]call for more cat researchers[/b][/url] at the factory, thousands of cat scientists have applied their CVs, and hundreds of them landed the job. Congratulations to them! Of course, not all the researchers hired by our HR dept. are skilled enough to perform certain researches, but they are still welcome to join because of how cute they are... That is, if the Factory is generating enough money, but that is a problem to be solved by our tireless engineers.

Still, even incompetent scientists are contributing to everyone's work! In fact, research has become so effective that certain engineers started experiencing confusion when planning their daily tasks. In his eternal wisdom, Dr. Katz decided to personally resolve this issue by offering [b]random requests to be completed at the Factory[/b]. Since KOTOVOD is a democratic institution, these tasks will be completely optional, of course. Hard labor 24/7 is still mandatory for all engineers, though.

In other news, [b]fishing by hand is legal again[/b] on Mars territory! Due to the delicacy of Martian biorobot fish species (kindly provided by the I.L.L.U.M.I.N.A.T.I.), it was previously considered unwise to try catching that fish with a tool as crude as fishing rod. But KOTOVOD population of cat residents is growing by day, and they must have their munchies, so every fish counts! Go catch some, engineer (if and when you don't have work stuff to do, which is unlikely)!

Here's how Mars fish looks like when being caught:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/720a04d6359dfb17d7abb64f2a42a37bfc200ed0.gif[/img]

(Please don't feel sorry for it: you know that those fish are not actual fish, don't you?)

All is well at Learning Factory. Glory to science! Glory to KOTOVOD!

[h2]Version 0.9.25 Released[/h2]
[list]
[*] In Tavern, there's a chance of spawning a cat with a perk that allows them taking data from Data Storage. If such cat is involved in a research project for which it has sufficient skills, that project speed is boosted
[*] A Data Storage now spawns on Campaign map; in Freeplay Mode, one is also added to player's inventory
[*] Small tasks with rewards are now given out, to make sure engineers are never idle
[*] Fishing by hand now animated
[*] UI improvements
[*] Performance optimization
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: KOTOVOD Worker #29: R&D Now Hiring
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078557/665c85b08ecbb5c4b1fda7bc2fa075366952ba3c.png[/img]
Even with the never-ending flow of cat customers, KOTOVOD campus is overflooded with excited cat faces these days! The rumors of Dr. Katz's glorious work have spreaded throughout the Solar System and cat researchers from all planets are flocking to the Learning Factory, seeking to become KOTOVOD's next researcher. 

Steady salaries, a comfortable Dormitory and all "Fish'n'Cheats" one can eat - those are the perks not available for human personnel, but every cat scientist will get them at their fullest! Of course, that means working 24/7, but the goal - building a better future for cats - is worth the cost. Besides, cat scientists are known to be capable of performing scientific researches even while sleeping.

The future is bright for KOTOVOD and cats all over the Universe! Glory to science!

[h2]Version 0.9.24 Released[/h2]
[list]
[*] New research mechanics: research speed now depends on cat scientists, employed to work on the Factory
[*] Each scientist has a dedicated set of skills in one or more research categories. In turn, each research has a complexity level. The research rate depends on whether or researchers' skills exceed the level of complexity
[*] Dormitory for hosting new researchers in the Monument
[*] Tons of new cat art
[*] Dr Katz has his own dedicated lab now
[*] 5 new achievements
[*] Fishing (no animation yet, though)
[*] Research queue: select more distant research project and all the previous researches will be scheduled automatically
[*] Researches can be put on hold (for accumulating money)
[*] Performance optimization
[*] UI fixes
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

If you have questions on the new research system, don't hesitate to join us during tomorrow's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1150090/announcements/detail/2996562204115226789]live stream event[/url], where we will clear out any possible misunderstandings!

See you there!
